jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Overview

Job Overview

Join Fairview’s Transformation Office
and help drive the initiatives that are shaping the future of healthcare. As a Project Manager
, you will lead and coordinate cross-functional projects that support strategic priorities, operational excellence, and organizational transformation. Working closely with leaders across the organization, you will oversee project planning, execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and performance tracking to ensure successful outcomes.

This fully remote role is ideal for a collaborative, results-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at managing multiple priorities, and enjoys turning complex challenges into impactful solutions. If you're passionate about innovation, continuous improvement, and delivering meaningful results, we invite you to be part of a team dedicated to advancing Fairview’s long-term success.

Responsibilities

Deliver moderately complex project plans and deliverables through effective management of schedule, scope, quality, value, issues, and risks. Accountable for supporting project owner including project communications, milestone tracking, resource planning, financials, risk assessment and contingency planning and escalation and resolution of critical issues to project sponsor/owners.
Provide project leadership in a way that supports leadership’s timely delivery on commitments/tasks supporting broader project deliverables. Align and project manage cross-organizational resources to ensure timely execution of assigned tasks. Identify project plan requirements and work with plan sponsors to ensure availability to deliver on project commitments.
Support leadership vision, approach, objectives, and key deliverables; identify/track key measures of success. Develop a comprehensive project plan, incorporating deliverables, resource plans, milestones, accountabilities, communication plan and timelines. Ensure project tracking and status are maintained appropriately. Conduct research and tasks needed to ensure comprehensive efforts are defined and performed. Provide regular documentation on plan development and progress, following all department standards. Ensure appropriate testing and quality reviews are conducted and receive sign-off.
Create and manage the overall project plan and communicate impacts to appropriate stakeholders. As applicable, lead and participate in regular post-implementation reviews and present project metrics to help evaluate project quality. Log, track, and escalate high priority project issues, risks and mitigation plan with leadership that may impact ability to deliver a quality project according to plan.
Work effectively with business partners, vendors, and staff to develop the project agenda and ensure agreement/adoption of project objectives/deliverables by affected constituencies. provide proactive project communication to project owner. Work to identify cross-organizational interdependencies and ensure appropriate integration to project plan. Effectively manage client expectations and resource requirements to ensure ownership and success.
Works closely with key stakeholders on development and maintenance of project metrics, KPIs (Key Performance Indicator), proformas and project valuations throughout the various phases of the project life cycle.
Serves as a thought partner and adviser to project owners/key system leaders
Leverages and applies knowledge of and experience with healthcare best practices and industry trends in innovation
Demonstrates ability to provide care or service adjusting approaches to reflect developmental level and cultural differences of population served
Partners with patient care giver in care/decision making.
Communicates in a respective manner.
Ensures a safe, secure environment.
Individualizes plan of care to meet patient needs.
Modifies clinical interventions based on population served.
Provides patient education based on as assessment of learning needs of patient/care giver.
Fulfills all organizational requirements
Completes all required learning relevant to the role
Complies with and maintains knowledge of all relevant laws, regulations, policies, procedures, and standards.
Fosters a culture of improvement, efficiency, and innovative thinking.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, Power-Point, Visio, Teams, SharePoint, and Outlook.

Required Qualifications

B.S./B.A. or equivalent combination of education/work experience or
3 years project management experience
Demonstrated ability to deal with ambiguity and to effectively manage within it
Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
Experience managing project plans, schedules, test plans, resources, and budgets
Strong knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite of tools
Successful record of accomplishment of delivering projects that meet business objectives
Ability to formally present project-related information clearly, concisely, and persuasively
Excellent facilitation skills and ability to drive resolution to issues

Preferred Qualifications

B.S./B.A.
Successful experience driving cross-functional and cross-organizational teams to meet project objectives
Proven skills in project management methodologies, processes, and industry standard tools
Ability to formally present project related information in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner and to the executive level.
Ability to relate well at all levels of the organization, building rapport and maintaining collaborative relationships
Health Care industry experience
Expert skills in project management methodologies, processes, and industry standard tools
Successful experience driving cross-organizational teams to meet project objectives. Leverages many years of experience to manage extensive projects, and is highly competent in the implementation of project results
PMP certification or other relevant certification or advanced degree in project/program management

Benefit Overview

Fairview offers a generous benefit package including but not limited to medical, dental, vision plans, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance, PTO and Sick and Safe Time, tuition reimbursement, retirement, early access to earned wages, and more! Please follow this link foradditional information: https://www.fairview.org/careers/benefits/noncontract

The posted pay range is for a 40-hour workweek (1.0 FTE). The actual rate of pay offered within this range may depend on several factors, such as FTE, skills, knowledge, relevant education, experience, and market conditions. Additionally, our organization values pay equity and considers the internal equity of our team when making any offer. Hiring at the maximum of the range is not typical. If your role is eligible for a sign-on bonus, the bonus program that is approved and in place at the time of offer, is what will be honored.

jobs.title: Project Manager/Estimator - Portsmouth, NH
jobs.description:
Remote flexibility with competitive salary + annual bonus.
Lead high-impact commercial projects with strong growth opportunities.

About Our Client

Our client is seeking an experienced Project Manager/Estimator to join our growing team. This full-time, remote role focuses on estimating commercial construction renovation projects. The Construction Project Manager is responsible for the management of the construction schedule, budget, quality, safety and relationships of a construction project in partnership with the Superintendent. This position is responsible for planning and coordination of all aspects of the construction process to effectively manage the risk at hand. This includes managing subcontractors, contract negotiations, client expectations, dispute resolution, material procurement and schedule production. In this role you may be required to travel up to 60% of the time. The position allows for the individual to work remote.

Job Description

Own project delivery from pre-construction through close-out, ensuring schedule, budget, quality, and safety objectives are met on every assigned project.
Develop and maintain the project schedule.
Conduct Risk Analyzes for all projects and proactively identify risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans before they become client-facing issues.
Track actual vs. budgeted costs weekly; maintain the Job Cost Report, ledgers, and overall project budget.
Select, contract, and manage subcontractors for each project, including pre-mobilization briefings and ongoing performance oversight.
Serve as the primary client-facing representative on assigned projects, maintaining continuous communication on schedule status, risk items, and decisions.
Oversee assigned Superintendents, ensuring they have what they need to run the site effectively, and hold them accountable to schedule, quality, and safety standards.
Manage all Submittals, RFIs, RFPs, SWAs, EWOs, PCOs, and material procurement; maintain complete, organized contract files.
Develop and issue monthly projections, change orders, and change proposals/pricing; create and monitor pay applications and cash flow.
Implement the project close-out process on every job, including a complete, organized electronic project file.
Collaborate with the Estimator during pre-construction to analyze scope, cost, and schedule feasibility and support accurate, buildable bids.
Leadership experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Project Manager, EBP Operations
jobs.description:
About Empower Community Care

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve.

Position Summary

Empower is hiring a dedicated, operations-focused Project Manager to drive infrastructure development, planning discipline, and cross-functional coordination across a portfolio of priorities within the EBP (evidence-based practice) division. This role blends classic project management fundamentals — planning, scheduling, risk management, budget and resource tracking, and performance reporting — with hands-on operational work: consolidating fragmented workflows into unified processes, project managing organizational transitions, designing and documenting scalable practices and processes, and project managing the development of new products and resources within Empower’s clinical models.

A key part of this role is partnering directly with leadership, including the C-suite and other executives, to translate strategic priorities into concrete operational plans and to drive those plans through execution. Fluency with automation and AI tools is a foundational requirement for this role, expected to be applied across process design, reporting, and day-to-day operational work.

Success depends on close, ongoing collaboration with all other functional areas — including Clinical, Finance, Technology, HR, and Sales & Marketing — to ensure operational changes are clinically sound, financially sustainable, well-positioned both internally and externally, and competently executed. Beyond these core priorities, this person will also serve as a utility resource for general process improvement and automation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Executive Partnership: Collaborate with organizational leaders to translate strategic priorities into structured, actionable operational plans. Provide regular progress updates, risk assessments, and recommendations to leadership to support decision-making, and help leadership teams think through sequencing and trade-offs as plans evolve
Project Planning & Execution: Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, and dependencies for cross-functional initiatives, partnering closely with Clinical, Finance, Marketing, and other functional teams to keep plans aligned and moving. Proactively identify risks and roadblocks, build mitigation plans, and keep initiatives moving through to completion. This includes managing organizational transitions such as leadership successions or role realignments, coordinating the handoff of responsibilities and redistribution of work across teams so nothing falls through the cracks
Operational Integration: Lead the consolidation of fragmented workflows — such as contract management, customer billing, deliverable tracking, and internal workforce resource planning — into single, coordinated structures. Convert existing practices into clear, repeatable, documented processes and define clear ownership and scalable operational structure in areas where responsibilities overlap and accountability is unclear
Product & Resource Development (Clinical Models): Project manage the development of new products and resources within Empower’s clinical models — such as new curricula, training materials, or program resources — coordinating across Clinical, Technology, and other stakeholders from concept through launch
Performance Measurement & Reporting: Define success metrics and KPIs for key initiatives, and build and maintain status reports and dashboards that keep stakeholders and leadership aligned on progress, risks, and outcomes
Resource & Budget Coordination: Support budget tracking, resource allocation, and vendor or contract coordination across initiatives, partnering with Finance to ensure operational plans remain financially sustainable
Continuous Improvement: Serve as a utility resource for general process improvement and automation across the division, supporting Empower’s broader move toward integrated, One Empower operations

Required Qualifications

Experience: Approximately 3–4 years in a behavioral health / human services operations role, or comparable experience in project or program management, including experience building project plans, tracking budgets, and managing risk
Automation & AI Fluency (Foundational): Working proficiency with automation and AI-enabled tools, and demonstrated ability to apply them to streamline processes, reporting, and daily operational work. This is a foundational requirement of the role, not an optional skill
Skills: Strong organizational, planning, and process-documentation skills; comfort working across ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives; budget and financial-model literacy; clear written and verbal communication with both internal teams and external partners, including experience presenting to senior leadership and executives
Work Style: Able to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple concurrent priorities and shifting between hands-on execution, higher-level process design, and executive-facing strategic planning

Preferred Skills & Experience

Certifications & Methodology: PMP certification, or equivalent project management training/methodology experience (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches)
Domain Familiarity: Familiarity with evidence-based practice models (e.g., FFT, MST, BSFT) is a plus, but not required

Additional Requirements

Background Check: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law and Empower’s standard hiring practices
Confidentiality: This role may involve exposure to confidential organizational, financial, and clinical program information. The employee must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with Empower’s internal data governance and confidentiality policies
Work Environment: This is a remote, computer-based position requiring prolonged periods of sitting and extended use of a computer, keyboard, and video-conferencing tools, along with travel of up to approximately 25% of the time for in-person meetings, leadership offsites, or site visits. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA
Other Duties: This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice

Benefits

Empower Community Care offers a competitive total-rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings; paid time off and holidays; and life insurance.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Empower Community Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Post-Sales Healthcare Software Delivery
jobs.description:
Building an AI‑first organisation
is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function — to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve , must drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.

Clinisys has built an unrivalled reputation for deploying complex diagnostic networks and academic centres – and is the only provider to repetitively deliver to all disciplines end-to-end – at scale. Fostering healthier communities. 

Job Overview

At Clinisys, we're looking for an experienced Project Manager to oversee a portfolio of post-sales software delivery projects across our healthcare solutions portfolio.

This role supports NHS and private healthcare customers throughout the UK, delivering a wide range of software enhancements, upgrades, integrations, configuration changes, and service engagements.

This is a fast-paced environment where Project Managers typically oversee multiple concurrent projects of varying complexity, ranging from short Professional Services engagements through to larger software delivery programmes valued up to £350,000 and spanning 6-18 months.

We're particularly interested in candidates with experience delivering software projects into the NHS, ideally within pathology, diagnostics, laboratory, healthcare IT, or related healthcare environments.

Responsibilities

Managing a large portfolio of concurrent customer-facing software delivery projects.
Coordinating software upgrades, system enhancements, integrations, migrations, and other post-sales service engagements.
Owning project plans, timelines, risks, dependencies, budgets, and resource requirements.
Acting as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project delivery.
Collaborating closely with Professional Services, Product, Technical, Support, and Customer Success teams.
Managing project governance, stakeholder communications, and reporting activities.
Identifying and mitigating project risks and issues to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
Supporting customers through implementation, testing, deployment, and project closure activities.
Ensuring projects are delivered within agreed scope, budget, and timescales.
Managing a high volume of projects simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality and contractual commitments.

Essential Experience

Minimum 3 years' experience as a Project Manager delivering customer-facing software projects.
Experience working for a software vendor, healthcare technology provider, SaaS provider, or technology services organisation.
Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects in a high-volume delivery environment.
Experience delivering software-only projects, including upgrades, enhancements, integrations, migrations, or application deployments.
Experience managing project plans, resources, budgets, risks, issues, and dependencies.
Working knowledge of project management methodologies such as PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, or similar.
Experience using project management and planning tools.
Experience managing project governance, reporting, and customer-facing delivery activities.

Highly Desirable Experience

Experience delivering projects into NHS organisations.
Experience working within pathology, laboratory, diagnostics, LIMS, EPR, or healthcare IT environments.
Experience delivering software solutions used within pathology laboratories.
Experience managing healthcare software projects within acute trusts, pathology networks, or diagnostic services.
Previous experience working in pathology services, laboratory operations, or healthcare delivery before moving into project management would be advantageous.
Experience engaging with pathology managers, laboratory managers, clinicians, and healthcare stakeholders.
Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot or similar generative AI tools to support project management activities, including planning, reporting, risk management, documentation, and delivery management.
Experience incorporating AI-assisted workflows into project delivery, governance, reporting, or operational processes.
Knowledge of Clinisys solutions would be beneficial but is not essential.

Additional Information

Remote-based role with occasional customer travel.
Standard 40-hour working week.
Occasional planned out-of-hours deployment activities may be required.
Opportunity to support critical healthcare and pathology systems used across NHS and private healthcare organisations throughout the UK.
Typical projects range from short Professional Services engagements of several consultancy days through to larger software delivery projects valued up to £350,000, with durations ranging from several weeks to 18 months.
Clinisys is investing in the use of AI-enabled technologies to enhance project delivery, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes. Experience using Microsoft Copilot or similar AI tools is desirable.

This role requires a working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and the ability to leverage them to improve processes and outcomes. A core understanding of AI concepts is required and must be able to demonstrate the use of AI tools in a professional setting.

Onboarding

As part of our onboarding process, all new employees will be required to attend / travel to the office on their first day of employment. This requirement is essential for onboarding activities, including the identity verification, completion of necessary documentation, receiving your IT equipment, introductions to key team members, and orientation to Clinisys policies and procedures.

IEM is seeking an experienced and proactive Operations Program Manager to lead and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of our highly configured, commercial and industrial product lines. This role will own the backlog and execution of complex, custom manufacturing requests, driving cross-functional alignment from conception through sales, build, test, and quality assurance.

The ideal candidate will bring strong program management discipline, operational rigor, and process leadership to help define, implement, and continuously improve a structured approach for handling specialized manufacturing projects.

Supply Chain & Long-Lead Materials: Monitor procurement of critical components, anticipate risks, and escalate/mitigate supply chain delays.
Capacity & Production Planning: Coordinate with operations teams to align project demand with production capacity and resources.
Project Tracking & Reporting: Establish and maintain detailed schedules, status reports, and dashboards for internal stakeholders and customers.
Customer Interface: Act as point of contact for project updates, change requests, and issue resolution, ensuring a positive customer experience.
Risk Management: Identify risks (technical, supply, capacity, commercial) and lead mitigation planning to protect project commitments.
Process Improvement: Contribute to standardizing project management practices, tools, and templates across strategic/custom projects.
Quality: Single point of contact for low voltage and medium voltage

Vision: Being coachable, curious and have a strong bias for action

Environment – Fast paced

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

About The Role

Horizon3.ai is building a Strategy & Programs function within Revenue Operations to help the organization successfully execute its highest-priority cross-functional initiatives as we continue to scale.

We are looking for a RevOps Program Manager to lead complex initiatives that span Revenue Operations and the broader business. This role will partner closely with teams including Sales Operations, Systems Operations, Deal Desk, Customer Operations, Partner Operations, Finance, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

This is not a traditional IT Project Manager role, nor is it a project coordinator position. The ideal candidate combines strong program management discipline with business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to create structure in ambiguous environments.

You will be responsible for turning strategic priorities into executable plans, aligning stakeholders around decisions and outcomes, identifying and managing risks and dependencies, and driving initiatives from definition through implementation.

As an early member of the Strategy & Programs team, you will also have the opportunity to help establish how project management operates within Revenue Operations as the function grows.

What You'll Do

Lead Strategic Initiatives

Lead moderately complex, cross-functional initiatives from initial scoping through implementation and closeout with little to no day-to-day direction.
Translate strategic priorities and business objectives into clear project plans, milestones, workstreams, dependencies, and success measures.
Establish appropriate project governance, operating cadences, decision-making structures, and stakeholder engagement models.
Manage multiple concurrent initiatives across different areas of the Revenue Operations organization.
Maintain accountability across project teams while recognizing that functional leaders and subject-matter experts retain ownership of functional decisions and outcomes.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

Coordinate work across Revenue Operations functions including Sales Operations, Systems Operations, Deal Desk, Customer Operations, and Partner Operations, as well as teams across the broader organization.
Facilitate effective working sessions, project meetings, leadership reviews, and decision-making forums.
Proactively identify dependencies, risks, blockers, and competing priorities and drive them toward resolution.
Establish clear owners, decisions, and next steps across project workstreams.
Escalate issues appropriately when additional leadership direction or decision-making is required.
Build alignment across teams with different priorities, perspectives, and areas of expertise.

Provide Project Governance & Visibility

Maintain project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and action items.
Develop concise, executive-ready project updates that communicate progress, risks, decisions required, and overall project health.
Ensure leadership has appropriate visibility into strategic initiatives without creating unnecessary administrative overhead.
Support portfolio-level visibility across active Strategy & Programs initiatives.
Help establish repeatable project management standards, templates, and governance practices for the organization.

Support Business & Operational Transformation

Projects May Include Initiatives Such As

Sales process and operating model changes
Territory, segmentation, and coverage initiatives
Pricing and packaging rollouts
Partner and channel program launches
Customer lifecycle improvements
Quote-to-Cash transformation
Revenue technology implementations
CRM and GTM systems initiatives
Systems integrations and automation
New GTM motions and commercialization programs
Data and reporting initiatives
Process redesign and operational scalability initiatives

The specific portfolio will evolve based on business priorities. Program Managers are expected to operate across both business-oriented and technology-enabled initiatives rather than being permanently assigned to a single Revenue Operations function.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of project, program, business operations, Revenue Operations, or related experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage moderately complex projects from scoping through implementation.
Experience working in a high-growth SaaS, technology, or similarly fast-paced environment.
Strong project planning, organization, prioritization, and risk-management skills.
Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar business processes and operating models.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than formal authority.
Experience coordinating stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of an organization.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating project status, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders.
Ability to identify problems, evaluate tradeoffs, exercise sound judgment, and drive teams toward practical solutions.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where processes or requirements may not yet be fully defined.
Ability to balance project management rigor with the speed and pragmatism required in a high-growth environment.

Experience That Could Make You Successful

We expect successful candidates to come from a variety of backgrounds. Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable:

Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, Partner Operations, Deal Desk, or Business Operations
Cross-functional GTM initiatives or commercial transformation
Business systems or revenue technology implementations
CRM, CPQ, CLM, ERP, or other enterprise technology programs
Product or Engineering partnership
Process improvement and operating model design
Change management and organizational transformation
Data, analytics, or data governance initiatives

What Success Looks Like

Successful Program Managers within Strategy & Programs:

Turn ambiguous business priorities into clear, executable plans.
Create accountability without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
Anticipate risks and dependencies rather than simply reporting them after they occur.
Drive timely decisions and maintain momentum across cross-functional teams.
Build trust with both business and technical stakeholders.
Give leaders clear visibility into project health, tradeoffs, and decisions required.
Help initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes while ensuring sustainable transition to the appropriate functional owners.
Continuously improve how Revenue Operations plans and delivers complex initiatives.

Who You Are

You are highly organized without being overly process-driven. You are comfortable walking into an initiative where not everything has been figured out yet and helping the team establish a path forward.

You ask good questions, learn unfamiliar areas quickly, and understand when to facilitate, when to challenge, and when to escalate. You are equally comfortable working with detailed project teams and communicating with senior leadership.

Most importantly, you view program management as more than maintaining timelines and scheduling meetings. You see the role as helping teams turn complex business decisions into coordinated, measurable execution.

Perks of Horizon3

Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.
Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.
Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.
Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation And Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

Base salary range: $145,000 - $160,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.
Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Infleqtion is seeking an ERP Sr. Program Manager to lead enterprise resource planning (ERP) programs and improvements across finance and operations. This role will turn business priorities into clear requirements, coordinated delivery plans and reliable system capabilities, working closely with business process owners, application teams and implementation partners.

The ERP Sr. Program Manager will own program delivery from discovery and planning through testing, deployment, adoption and transition to support. The ideal candidate combines strong ERP process knowledge with disciplined program management, practical controls awareness and the ability to coordinate detailed work across business and technical teams. This role will operate within enterprise portfolio priorities and the common software development lifecycle (SDLC) framework.

Key Responsibilities

ERP Planning and Program Delivery

Develop and maintain the ERP program roadmap and delivery plans with business sponsors and application leadership, aligning proposed initiatives with enterprise priorities and available capacity
Lead ERP implementations, enhancements, integrations, upgrades and process improvements from initial scoping through stabilization and operational handover, including connections to CRM and other business applications that support customer data, orders and billing
Define program scope, outcomes, milestones, resource needs and budgets; manage interdependent workstreams and cross-functional delivery risks, and hold implementation partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and knowledge transfer
Translate business needs into documented requirements and acceptance criteria across finance, accounts payable, procurement, inventory, manufacturing and order management
Facilitate process and solution decisions with the appropriate business and technical owners; document tradeoffs and escalate accounting, architecture, security or policy decisions to accountable leaders
Maintain clear plans, decision logs, issue and risk registers, change requests and status reporting; bring sponsors timely recommendations when scope, cost or delivery dates are at risk

Testing, Controls and Deployment

Coordinate the full SDLC, including requirements, solution design, configuration or development, integration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness and deployment
Lead user acceptance testing and quality assurance (UAT/QA) planning with business users and technical teams, ensuring realistic scenarios, documented expected and actual results, defect ownership, remediation, retesting and sign-off
Embed practical change management, role-based access and segregation-of-duties considerations into ERP delivery in partnership with finance, security and control owners
Ensure changes follow established authorization and evidence requirements, with appropriate review of elevated access, configuration changes and release readiness
Coordinate data migration, cleansing, validation and reconciliation with data and process owners, including clear acceptance criteria for integrations and converted records
Manage cutover, contingency and post-deployment support plans; verify operational readiness and track issues through stabilization

Business Adoption and Continuous Improvement

Lead change, communication and training plans grounded in real business scenarios, user responsibilities, system functionality and relevant controls; coordinate effective materials and sessions with business and technical owners
Partner with support teams to identify recurring issues, translate improvement opportunities into the ERP backlog and protect capacity for critical operational needs
Ensure new capabilities have documented support ownership, procedures and escalation paths before handover
Track adoption, process performance and program outcomes with business owners; apply lessons learned to improve subsequent releases
Contribute ERP delivery practices, templates and reporting to the PMO and use the common demand-intake, prioritization and governance processes

Requirements

Experience leading ERP initiatives across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement and IT, including managing team priorities, vendors and system governance
Hands-on experience with NetSuite OneWorld in a multi-subsidiary environment
Strong understanding of financial processes, inventory and costing, and the general ledger impact of ERP changes
Ability to manage program scope, schedules, budgets and risks, prioritize with business leaders, and communicate clearly with executives and auditors
Experience overseeing integrations, data migration, UAT/QA and controlled releases through business sign-off, cutover, training and handover
Practical experience with approval workflows, role-based access, segregation of duties, SOX controls and audit support

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a growing technology, engineering, research or manufacturing organization, including ERP integration with CRM and other business applications
Experience working within or helping mature a PMO, common SDLC or portfolio governance model
Relevant ERP, project-management or business-analysis credentials, or equivalent demonstrated experience

Soft Skills

Strong ownership, attention to detail and consistent follow-through
Ability to influence across functions, resolve competing priorities and keep decisions moving
Clear communication that makes business impact, options and next actions easy to understand
Sound judgment about when to act independently and when to seek specialist or leadership decisions

Working Conditions And Physical Requirements

Work is primarily computer-based and requires close collaboration with business users, technical teams and external partners. Releases and cutovers may require planned work outside normal business hours.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

Why join Bolt?

Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.

About The Role

As a Senior Program Manager, you'll own the supply operations strategy for Bolt's priority ride categories and customer segments, making sure the right supply is available to meet demand. You'll focus on growing eligible active supply across XL/XXL, two- and three-wheelers, and Comfort/Premium, while improving supply availability and service quality for Business Accounts. Working across Central and Local Operations, Riders, Product, Analytics, and Fleet & Vehicles, you'll turn Riders category and segment ambitions into measurable supply targets, run targeted supply experiments and develop a scalable supply model at category level.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities

Define and own category-level supply plans, including eligible Monthly Active Partner targets across priority cities, identifying gaps in driver availability, vehicle eligibility and engagement.
Partner with Rider Ops, Growth and local teams to build business cases for category-specific supply acquisition across campaign channels, agreeing priorities, investment and execution plans, and partner with Product to submit cases for supply-priority needs that improve utilization.
Define and pilot Business Account supply levers, including reviewing driver quality opportunities and vehicle eligibility, and design and implement quality requirements for Comfort/Premium access.
Develop driver engagement initiatives that increase participation in eligible categories where and when supply is needed.
Define success metrics and evaluate pilots, balancing category and segment gains against driver earnings and the impact on wider marketplace supply, then translate successful pilots into repeatable playbooks with clear ownership and ongoing performance monitoring across markets.

About You

Proven experience in programme or category management, category operations, supply growth or a related field, with a strong understanding of marketplace mechanics, supply acquisition and driver or partner engagement.
Proven experience designing and scaling operational programmes across multiple markets.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose performance gaps, design experiments and translate data into actionable recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Experience working in fast-paced, cross-regional environments; mobility, fleet or business travel experience is an advantage.

Why you'll love it here

Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.

Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.

Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there's a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You're still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don't tick every box, please consider applying!

You're the program manager who can land Multi-Tiered System of Supports MTSS Level 3 across multiple public districts, not just one campus. You build district-specific implementation plans, run engaging PD that actually changes practice, and stand up ongoing support that solves problems the first time. You track adoption and student performance with rigor, turn that data into clear next steps, and you keep refining the playbook so the next rollout is faster and cleaner.

You know MTSS/RTI cold, speak K-12 fluently, and you can earn trust with educators while running a tight project timeline.

We're standardizing a high-leverage, Level 3 intervention and scaling it with technology so districts see measurable student gains sooner, at lower friction. That means less bespoke consulting, more repeatable wins. If you like building repeatable systems that outperform “heroic effort,” this is where the work pays off: a forward-thinking, entrepreneurial team that values autonomy and expects you to shape how the intervention scales.

This is not a district MTSS coordinator job focused on one system's politics. It's a multi-district implementation role that scales a standardized, outcome-driven solution. It's not a classic EdTech implementation coordinator either; your scorecard is adoption quality and student outcomes. Compared to a private-K12 CSM, you're not stewarding individual accounts; you're standing up an intervention program across public districts and proving it works, then making it easier to repeat.

You'll manage implementations across multiple public school districts simultaneously, balancing stakeholder alignment, educator enablement, and measurable adoption outcomes. You'll partner with product and ops, turn field feedback into improvements, and be the person districts remember when the implementation works and students move. If you can design and execute tailored timelines, deliver training people want to attend, mine usage and performance data for truth, and iterate processes without waiting for permission, step in. The right candidate will recognize themselves here and should apply.

What You Will Be Doing

Leading district implementation rollouts from kickoff through sustained adoption of our MTSS framework
Designing and executing district implementation plans that drive high adoption of our MTSS framework
Tracking implementation fidelity, adoption trends, and student performance data to identify improvement opportunities
Delivering engaging professional development that leaves educators confident and excited about using our solution
Refining implementation playbooks and operational processes so each rollout becomes faster and more repeatable

What You Won’t Be Doing

Developing custom one-off solutions instead of implementing our proven, standardized approach
Focusing on post-implementation account management rather than driving successful adoption
Getting buried in administrative paperwork instead of driving meaningful outcomes
Working with a single district rather than implementing across multiple school systems

Educational Program Manager Key Responsibilities

Lead high-fidelity district implementation of our technology-enabled MTSS framework so educators adopt it consistently and students receive faster, more effective intervention support.

Basic Requirements

At least 2 years of experience in K-12 education in MTSS (Multi-Tiered System of Supports), RTI (Response to Intervention), or program coordination
Experience analyzing student performance data and turning findings into actionable next steps
Located in the United States and willing to travel up to 30% for on-site training
Eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship

About Studient

Studient is devoted to learning—and to transforming education for the 21st century.

Our AI-powered Motivention™ platform goes beyond simply adding AI to outdated systems. While traditional approaches often leave struggling students behind, Motivention creates real-time,personalized mastery pathways tailored to how each student learns best and supports it with motivation science.

jobs.description:
Description

ABOUT US

Interfaith America is a national nonprofit organization based in Chicago. We believe that religious diversity is a foundational American strength, and we are building a nation that achieves that promise for the common good. Our mission is to inspire, equip, and connect organizations and leaders to unlock the potential of America’s religious diversity. We leverage our expertise in interfaith leadership in different sectors and spaces in American life, such as higher education, health, public policy, racial equity, corporations/business, tech – giving leaders and institutions the tools and resources they need to positively engage religious diversity for the common good.

At Interfaith America, we are ever adapting and changing. We look for people who set audacious goals and love that one workday may not be like the next. We have a strong commitment to pluralism and building bridges across deep differences. Our programs help people build skills to bridge deep ideological divides. Our work is about staying in relationship with one another and contributing to the common good even when we might disagree on fundamental things. We seek to attract and retain a team of staff comprised of a wide variety of views and backgrounds we need to achieve our vision, especially people from communities historically underrepresented in interfaith work.

THIS POSITION

Interfaith America has worked with American colleges and universities for over twenty years. We are committed to providing high-quality programming that suffuses and sustains higher education’s commitment to engaging religious diversity and advances a culture of pluralism more broadly on campuses. The Program Manager (Campus Partnerships) is an essential part of the Campus Partnerships team within IA’s Higher Education sector. While all IA program managers engage religious and worldview diversity with a variety of constituents, this position will specifically focus on worldview diversity, interfaith cooperation, and civic pluralism within postsecondary contexts. This position will require close collaboration with external campus partners, including senior-level leadership such as university presidents, chancellors, and senior administrators. Additionally, responsibilities may involve close collaboration with external partners, such as academic associations and nonprofit organizations, to facilitate IA’s campus work.

Responsibilities

Work with the Director of Campus Partnerships to manage comprehensive on-campus consultation projects to support campuses in developing a pluralism strategy Deploy Interfaith America programs and theories of civic and interfaith cooperation when working on projects involving university presidents, chancellors, senior administrators, and other campus constituencies
Execute pieces of work on Interfaith America projects, including data tracking in line with project goals and impact; CRM responsibilities; and administrative tasks
Lead event planning and execution for IA’s higher education conferences pertaining to university presidents, chancellors, and senior administrators, in collaboration with other IA staff members and external vendors
Coordinate and contribute to IA strategies and initiatives focused on HBCU institutions
Cultivate relationships with civic partners (e.g. peers at non-profits), academic associations, and campus constituents
Develop and facilitate in-person and virtual trainings for campus partners
Manage assigned Interfaith America programs and grants, including overseeing grant or program design, outreach, programming, evaluation, and finances (budgets, payments, etc.)
Represent Interfaith America through presentations and attendance at conferences, on campus visits, and at IA events
Coordinate and contribute to key elements of the Higher Education Student Affairs (HESA) Fellowship, including virtual gatherings, and elective writing and thought leadership opportunities for fellows
Support broader HESA Faculty Fellowship priorities such as the promotion, planning, and execution of the annual in-person convening
Contribute to other projects within IA’s Higher Education team as assigned

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

A bachelor’s degree
3–5 years of professional experience in a related field, including higher education, student affairs, interfaith work, consulting, etc.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills
Ability to balance and prioritize multiple ongoing projects from multiple stakeholders
Ability to meet deadlines and work well under pressure
Strong attention to detail
Strong competence in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
Proven project management and organizational skills
Demonstrated effectiveness in interfacing with multiple constituencies, such as non-profit partners; campus administrators, faculty, staff or students

Preferred Qualifications (not Required)

Advanced degree in Higher Education, Civic Leadership, Religious Studies, Nonprofit Management, or Project Management
Experience in in-person and online training, facilitation, consulting, education, and/or related skill sets
Experience with higher education or non-profit evaluation and assessment
Demonstrated ability to engage stakeholders in substantive discussions about religious and worldview diversity, interfaith cooperation, and civic pluralism
Experience developing and implementing strategies with an “engaging deep differences” approach to diversity work within higher education
Experience with networking and building relationships or coalitions within higher education

Location: This position will work 2-3 days per week from our Chicago Loop office and 2-3 days per week from home

Travel: Approximately 15–20% of work time will be traveling to colleges/universities, and conferences across the country (average throughout year; may be more during peak academic and conference seasons); can expect to work occasional nights and weekends

Supervision: Director of Campus Partnerships

Salary: $70,000-$80,000

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager who can lead high-visibility, large enterprise implementations that span both critical business and technology workstreams. This is a 12 months contract to hire hybrid (onsite/remote) position with our client in Raleigh, North Carolina.
In this role as a Senior Program Manager, you will be Operating at the intersection of executive strategy and execution, you will oversee multi-million-dollar portfolios—including insurance core-system and Policy Administration System (PAS) transformations.

As a Senior Program Manager your primary responsibility is to drive delivery through a complex ecosystem of internal teams and external providers. This role requires an expert in multi-vendor integration, scope/change control, and strict contract/SOW governance. Crucially, you must possess the unique leadership ability to challenge vendors, when necessary, without destroying the partnership. We prioritize candidates with a proven track record of successful implementation experience, not just certifications.

Vendor-Led Delivery Oversight: Serve as the primary accountability partner for external system integrators (SIs), software providers, and consultants.
Contract & SOW Governance: Manage the execution of complex vendor agreements, ensuring all deliverables, milestones, and SLAs are met before signing off on invoices.
Multi-Vendor Integration: Orchestrate delivery across multiple distinct technology and consulting vendors, ensuring seamless collaboration and minimizing finger-pointing.

Financial & Program Forecasting: Direct capital and operational budget tracking. Deliver precise monthly financial forecasts, burn-rate metrics, and variance analyses.
Executive Steering Committees: Act as the strategic voice of the program. Prepare and deliver transparent, data-driven status updates, risk trade-offs, and critical decision frameworks to executive leadership and steering committees.

Required Skills and Qualifications as a Senior Program Manager:

· 10+ years of dedicated program management experience leading large enterprise
Demonstrated history of bringing complex, multi-year programs to successful production go-live. Real-world delivery experience

jobs.description:
Job Description

About us:

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're Incredibly Honored To Have Been Recognized By

CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About This Role In The Team

As an Implementation Manager at BVNK, you will own the successful implementation of customers onto the BVNK platform following commercial close and handoff from Solutions Engineering.

You will act as the primary implementation partner for the customer, coordinating technical integration, configuration, testing, dependencies, and internal stakeholders to move customers efficiently from signed contract to production go-live.

This role combines technical expertise, program management, and customer leadership. You will be accountable for maintaining implementation momentum, resolving blockers, managing risk, and ensuring customers launch successfully against clearly defined scope and timelines.

Key Areas Of Responsibility

Own customer implementations from handoff by Solutions Engineering through successful production go-live.
Establish and manage implementation plans, milestones, dependencies, responsibilities, and target launch dates.
Lead customer implementation kickoffs and establish clear governance and ways of working for the delivery process.
Guide customers through integration with BVNK’s APIs, webhooks, authentication methods, and payment infrastructure.
Provide technical guidance and best practices throughout implementation while ensuring alignment with the solution agreed during the sales process.
Coordinate testing, sandbox integration, configuration, certification, operational readiness, and production launch activities.
Act as the primary point of coordination between customers and BVNK teams during implementation.
Work closely with Engineering, Product, Compliance, Operations, and other internal teams to resolve implementation blockers and dependencies.
Troubleshoot technical integration issues and coordinate escalation to specialist teams where required.
Proactively identify risks to scope, timeline, or launch readiness and establish clear mitigation plans.
Maintain clear communication with customer and internal stakeholders regarding implementation progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Manage changes to implementation scope and ensure material changes are appropriately assessed and agreed.
Ensure customer implementations meet BVNK’s technical and operational standards before production launch.
Create repeatable implementation processes, playbooks, documentation, and best practices that improve time-to-live and scalability.
Identify recurring implementation friction and provide structured feedback to Product, Engineering, and Solutions Engineering.
Conduct a structured post-launch handoff to the appropriate ongoing customer owner once implementation objectives have been achieved.

What We Need From You

Strong technical understanding of APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, and software integrations.
Experience in technical implementation, delivery, integration management, professional services, technical project management, or a similar customer-facing role.
Strong understanding of payments infrastructure and payment flows; experience with stablecoins, digital assets, or crypto payment rails is highly advantageous.
Proven ability to manage complex customer implementations involving multiple technical and business stakeholders.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to establish plans, manage dependencies, and drive customers and internal teams toward deadlines.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and work effectively with Engineering and Product teams to resolve blockers.
Excellent customer communication skills, including the ability to set expectations and manage difficult conversations when timelines or requirements change.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations.
Ability to identify risks early, escalate appropriately, and maintain accountability across cross-functional teams.
A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset focused on achieving successful customer outcomes and reducing time to value.

What You Can Expect From Us

Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
A flexible approach to holiday
Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.

We are proud to be the largest and most recognized brand in automation and control solutions, and the premier technology partner for fortune 500 businesses globally. The position requires knowledge of project management methodologies, manufacturing NPI processes, and supply/demand requirements. It requires the ability to translate technical and supply chain complexity into clear, actionable plans and executive-level communication. Create project plans for manufacturing process and support of NPI products (plan deliverables, create schedule baseline, manage dependencies)

Create procurement plans, manage custom designed part FAI approvals, identify and manage long lead parts to be ready for prototype and production builds.
Coordinate launch plans for internal direct launches at Orangeburg factory, direct launches or transfer of products to contract manufacturers, host Launch Readiness Reviews with all stakeholders.
Review product roadmaps with Engineering PMO and Product Management, identify product discontinuations, replacement products, work with supply chain to plan demand changes.

5 - 8 years experience in Project Management, ability to lead multiple large scale projects simultaneously
Strong Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Power BI skills
Strong Project Management process skills
Strong data analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills
Teamwork, communication and interpersonal skills
Enterprise resource planning skills (SAP a plus)

jobs.title: Project Manager (88372)
jobs.description:
Overview

Founded in 1973, Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is a leading global security company, providing a full range of physical security services to government and commercial customers on four continents. Inter-Con specializes in providing customized security services to clients whose needs exceed the capabilities of traditional guard firms. Clients include the Departments of State, Justice, Homeland Security, Energy, and Defense, as well as Fortune 500 companies, major public utilities, and ultra-high net worth individuals.

Inter-Con employs over 35,000 security personnel world-wide, trained and managed by a team of professionals with unsurpassed military, law enforcement, and security experience. Inter-Con remains 100% family owned and managed and operates as the industry leader in the field of customized, high-requirement security solutions.

Inter-Con is Everywhere Security Matters.

Job Summary

Inter-Con Security Systems is seeking a Project Manager to oversee daily security operations for a large, geographically dispersed public social services contract. The contract includes 19 locations, approximately 3,000 weekly security service hours, and approximately 70 security officers across northern Los Angeles County and surrounding communities.

The Project Manager serves as a client liaison and coordinates security services, supervises assigned personnel, and manages timekeeping, personnel administration, and payroll support. This hands-on leadership role requires regular site visits, strong follow-through, and the ability to balance field operations with accurate administrative support.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Oversee day-to-day security service delivery across assigned locations, ensuring operations meet contract requirements, client expectations, and Inter-Con procedures.
Serve as a liaison with the Client Security personnel; address service concerns and coordinate timely follow-up.
Supervise assigned supervisors and security officers, communicate expectations, coach performance, and coordinate personnel matters with appropriate Inter-Con teams.
Coordinate staffing, schedules, and coverage with supervisors to maintain required service levels and address attendance or coverage issues.
Review timekeeping records for accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and provide timely personnel and payroll support.
Conduct regular site visits, including weekly visits to outlying locations, to assess service quality, support employees, and maintain client relationships.
Coordinate responses to operational issues and incidents, ensure appropriate escalation, and maintain clear documentation and follow-through.
Prepare and maintain operational reports, staffing records, and other required administrative documentation.
Partner with the Contract Manager on reporting, contract compliance, and resource needs; apply financial awareness to staffing and overtime decisions.
Support contract transition activities, personnel readiness, and implementation of site procedures.
Perform other duties related to security operations and contract service delivery as assigned.

Required Qualifications

At least three years of experience within the last five years providing security management services on a contract of similar size and scope.
High school diploma or equivalent.
Experience supervising security personnel and coordinating operations across multiple locations.
Strong client service, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to maintain accurate timekeeping, personnel records, payroll support documentation, and operational reports.
Financial acumen, including an understanding of how staffing, scheduling, and overtime affect contract operations.
Proficiency with standard business software and the ability to learn scheduling, timekeeping, and reporting systems.
Ability to travel regularly throughout the service area and conduct weekly visits to outlying sites.
Ability to successfully complete required background screening.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing security services in public-facing government or social services environments.
Experience supporting a contract transition or new service launch.
Bilingual communication skills.

Work Environment and Travel

The position combines office administration with field oversight at client locations. Commerce is the preferred base, with recruiting also focused on the Sylmar area. The service footprint includes Pomona, El Monte, Monterey Park, Burbank, Chatsworth, Palmdale, Lancaster, and surrounding communities. Regular travel between these sites is an essential part of the role.

Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Disability/Veteran.

Hybrid Work Model

The BEST program operates under the Office of the Comptroller (CTR) hybrid work model. Under this policy, employees are currently required to work a minimum of four (4) business days per month (two (2) set by management and two (2) set by the employee) on-site at CTR’s Boston office and may work remotely the remainder of the time at a location approved by their supervisor, so long as they comply with the requirements of the telework policy. Under this policy, all employees must be able to report to the Boston office with little or no notice, even including the same workday should an exigent circumstance arise. Therefore, a reasonable proximity to the office is necessary. CTR does not reimburse for employees to travel to the office.

About the Role

Position Summary

The BEST Program Security Architect will work for the BEST Solution Technical Lead and Deputy Program Manager to support the adoption of the future state end user security solution and protocols. Together with the BEST PMO and BEST Phase 2 Technical Lead, Comptroller Risk Management Team, Product Vendor, Systems Integrator (SI), Office of the Comptroller, and Executive Office of Technology Services and Security (EOTSS) staff to deploy technical controls to meet specific end-user security requirements, enable processes and standards to ensure that security configurations are maintained in the new Human Resource Management and Payroll solution.

As a key member of the project’s Security Team, the Risk and Compliance Lead will work closely with other team members to develop and implement a comprehensive information security program.

Responsibilities

This includes:

Design and recommend protocols and procedures for monitoring the product vendor’s performance against Service Level Agreement standards regarding data security, annual security audits, and disaster recovery testing.

The Software as a Solution (SaaS) model chosen by the Commonwealth includes data security protocols and procedures that are audited annually by a third party. The BEST Risk and Compliance Lead will assist the Commonwealth in implementing necessary procedures to meet risk mitigation requirements and monitor vendor compliance with security protocols.

This role involves collaborating with program functional teams to identify end-user roles and permissions for implementing the new Human Resource and Payroll solution across all agencies and user types, ensuring appropriate data access. User security procedures will be developed in conjunction with the BEST Phase 2 Technical Lead, Comptroller Risk Management Team, the system integration and product vendor, and agency staff responsible for user provisioning and deprovisioning.

In addition this position will coordinate with the BEST program's Independent Verification and Validation (IV &V) vendor necessary to ensure proper adoption.
