Knowledge of applicable regulations and guidance, including Regulation E, Regulation CC, Regulation V, UCC, NACHA Operating Rules, Visa Operating Rules, BSA requirements, FinCEN SAR requirements, and OCC fraud risk management guidance.
Knowledge of hold harmless agreements, breach of warranty claims, indemnification processes, adjustments, and interbank fraud recovery practices.
Ability to identify control weaknesses, process gaps, and emerging fraud risks and develop practical recommendations for mitigation.
Strong analytical, investigative, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of management.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Demonstrated ability to effectively manage high-risk, time-sensitive fraud events and make complex risk-based decisions while balancing fraud mitigation, customer experience, operational considerations, and regulatory expectations.
Ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.description:

Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data & Operations team based in Pune, India. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.

What You’ll Be Doing

The primary responsibilities for this role include:

Own the end-to-end delivery of non-native dashboards for your assigned business function (G&A, R&D, or GTM), combining data across multiple source systems into a single, accurate view
Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented
Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions
Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision-ready intelligence
Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting
Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs
Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live
Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early
Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated
Contribute to cross-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure
Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape

3-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role

Experience working with large datasets across multiple systems and understanding how to combine them into coherent reporting
Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous QA on data outputs and maintain high standards of accuracy

jobs.description:
Role Overview

BRP’s Global Security Team is seeking a motivated Intelligence Analyst to support global intelligence, threat monitoring, and situational awareness activities that protect BRP’s people, property, products, and brand reputation.

Based in Mexico (Juárez Campus), the Intelligence Analyst will support the Intelligence Lead and Global Security team in collecting, analyzing, and disseminating information related to security risks affecting BRP’s manufacturing sites, production & logistics operations, and in supporting Mexico-based incident & investigation management.

This role is ideal for a professional looking to develop expertise in the intelligence cycle within a corporate security environment, with a strong focus on regional risk (Mexico/Latin America) and progressively on BRP global operations.

Key Responsibilities

Intelligence Monitoring, Collection and Proactivity

Conduct continuous monitoring of regional (Mexico/LATAM) security risks, including crime and safety awareness, transnational criminal organizations, foreign terrorist organizations, and geopolitical trends, using internal and external tools and sources.
Track news, social media, government advisories, and intelligence alerts to identify threats impacting BRP operations, personnel, or supply chain.
Support the maintenance of intelligence trackers, databases, and situational awareness dashboards.

Monthly Intelligence Reports
Intelligence Advisories, Briefs, and Special Intelligence Reports

Ensure intelligence outputs are clear, concise, and actionable for stakeholders.

Incident & Investigation Support

Act as a subject-matter expert on incident classification in the ONTIC System and help Security teams navigate the platform’s processes for investigation management.
Provide analytical support to security incidents and investigations by gathering background intelligence and open-source data.
Help identify patterns or trends across incidents to support proactive risk mitigation.
Support the Mexico Security Team in conducting investigations when required.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Support

Collaborate with local site teams in Mexico to enhance situational awareness and risk reporting.
Participate in meetings, briefings, and training sessions to deepen knowledge of corporate security practices.

Security Studies

Criminology

Familiarity with security risks in Mexico and Latin America is a strong asset

Proficiency in Google Suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides)
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment
Strong ethical standards with heavy handling of sensitive and confidential information

jobs.title: OSINT Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Mission Statement

At Aperio Global, we bring together experts in cybersecurity, AI, data analytics, and cloud technologies to solve complex national security challenges. We focus on work where our expertise creates the greatest impact.

Our team includes technologists, Intelligence Community veterans, and security professionals who believe the best solutions come from collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence. From cyber operations and AI platforms to cloud-native software and emerging technologies, our work speaks for itself.

Come Solve With Us

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, retirement savings with company match, generous paid time off, and professional development. We invest in our people because great missions require great teams.

Mid - to Senior Open-Source Analyst

Washington, DC | On-Site | Active and Current TS/SCI Required

Turn Open-Source Information Into Actionable Intelligence

Aperio Global is seeking experienced Mid-Career to Senior Open-Source Analysts to join our mission-focused team supporting critical national security requirements in Washington, DC.

This is an opportunity for intelligence professionals who know how to move beyond simply finding information. We’re looking for analysts who can discover, assess, connect, and interpret publicly available information (PAI) to help illuminate complex problems, identify emerging developments, and deliver intelligence that supports real-world missions.

If you enjoy digging deeper, connecting seemingly unrelated information, and turning large volumes of open-source data into meaningful intelligence, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Do:

As a Mid-Career to Senior Open-Source Analyst, you will:

Conduct analysis using intelligence and information from multiple sources to assess, interpret, forecast, and explain national security issues and emerging developments that are regional or functional in nature.

Provide all-source and open-source analytic support to intelligence collection, operations, investigations, targeting, and other defense intelligence requirements.

Research and exploit publicly available information, social media, digital platforms, commercial databases, and other Internet-based sources.

Apply qualitative and quantitative analytic methodologies to complex intelligence problems.

Remain current on developments in academia, technology, and other disciplines that can enhance intelligence tradecraft and analytic methodology.

Review analytic products for logical arguments, intelligence tradecraft standards, sourcing, and adequate support for conclusions.

Challenge assumptions and test the analytic rigor of intelligence products.

Apply advanced Internet research techniques, including Boolean logic, advanced search methodologies, database exploitation, social networking tools, and commercial or industry-specific resources.

Support complex problem sets, including areas such as cryptocurrency, virtual assets, digital ecosystems, and emerging technologies.

What You Bring:

U.S. Citizenship

Active TS/SCI security clearance

Bachelor’s degree

Demonstrated experience using Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) tools and methodologies

Experience working with complex problem sets such as cryptocurrency and virtual assets

Professional experience related to OSINT research, collection management, intelligence analysis, PAI exploitation, or social media exploitation

Experience accessing, researching, and exploiting global and regional social media and digital platforms

Experience conducting open-source research, all-source intelligence analysis, or targeting

Knowledge of advanced Internet-based research techniques, including Boolean logic, advanced search techniques, search engines, specialized databases, social media, social networking tools, and commercial or industry databases

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

Ability to work rotating shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays; to perform under high stress and short suspense; and to travel domestically and internationally (vaccinations may be required).

Why Aperio Global?

At Aperio Global, we bring together intelligence professionals, technologists, engineers, and mission experts to solve difficult national security challenges. We value people who are intellectually curious, technically capable, and willing to challenge assumptions.

Here, you won't simply search for information—you'll help make sense of it, connect it, and turn it into intelligence that matters.

Ready to bring your OSINT expertise to the mission? Join Aperio Global.

Salary Range: 140-180

The salary range for this role represents Aperio’s good-faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Placement within the range is based on multiple factors, including but not limited to an individual’s qualifications, relevant experience, education, certifications, technical skills, contract labor categories and/or rates, work location, market conditions, and business needs.

Benefits

At Aperio Global, we understand the value of investing in our most important asset—our employees. That's why we have crafted a comprehensive benefits package designed to help you make the best decision for yourself, your family and your lifestyle. For additional details, contact our talent acquisition team.

Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) with 100% employer match up to 6%
Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
Short Term & Long Term Disability
Professional Development
(and much more)

Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs — never on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy/childbirth, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, ethnicity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

The Market Intelligence (MI) team within the Keysight Corporate Strategy Office enables sustained corporate growth by equipping Keysight’s businesses with timely, accurate, and objective insights that drive revenue and profit growth, customer success, and brand loyalty.

A Keysight Market Intelligence Analyst accelerates and improves the quality of corporate strategic decisions by providing research, modeling, and analysis across Keysight’s industries, customers, and competitors. We work with partners across the company to facilitate and influence insights from the external market environment. Key contributions include Keysight’s strategic planning process, macroeconomic and geopolitical assessment, market modeling, growth opportunity assessments, executive and investor relations support, and ad hoc industry, customer and peer analysis. As the external environment continues to change, the job content is characterized as dynamic and thought-provoking.

Keysight SAM & TAM Market Scanning, Analysis and Modeling

Provide a consistent framework and process for creating and updating market models. Identify and track market, competitive, econometric, and industry trends and drivers.
Create thorough and objective financial models and projections
Coordinate, and collaborate with internal industry and solution partners to create consistent models of Keysight’s chosen market segments

Macroeconomic, Industry, Customer, and Peer Analysis

Provide quarterly reporting deliverables, including revenue narratives and market news to support earnings calls
Research market segments, analyze technology trends and customer performance, and monitor and synthesize peer performance
Provide market share performance analysis for Keysight and its key peers, including sub-segment and regional analysis where available

Strategic Consulting

Maintain always-ready market and scenario trackers to support rapid, ad hoc requests from CEO and CSO leadership
Deliver objective analysis of an opportunity space, including market and competitive dynamics, using Keysight standard strategy tools
Identify attributes of a differentiated, sustainable business model, and facilitate value-creation strategy development
Deliver balanced scenario analysis and recommendations to an executive audience while documenting key findings and sources

Modernization of Tools and Processes

Apply AI and automation (e.g., LLM-based agents, automated data pipelines) to streamline research, data gathering, market modeling, and reporting workflows
Use AI-assisted analysis, visualization, and writing tools to elevate the impact and polish of executive deliverables

Qualifications

Expertise:

Understanding growth drivers and dynamics in the automotive, energy, industrial, and semiconductor industries. Familiarity with wireless and wireline telecommunications and aerospace/defense industries.
Knowledge of the economy, financial concepts, corporate accounting, and investor-relations fluency
Skilled in applying AI and automation tools to accelerate research, elevate deliverable quality, and safeguard data integrity
Working knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals

Strategic

Demonstrated ability to quickly acquire an in-depth knowledge of customer, market, competitive, business, and technology situation and integrate it into strategies that deliver sustainable competitive advantage
Demonstrated ability and experience networking with, and quickly mobilizing, key individuals inside and outside the organization to drive strategic dialog and decisions

Process

Demonstrated ability to create and facilitate processes across distributed organizations
Able to triage ambiguous, time-sensitive requests and deliver rigorous analysis on compressed timelines
Skilled in analyzing and summarizing market research and using strategic frameworks
Working proficiency with data and automation tools to build scalable, repeatable models and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Spotfire, Python, Salesforce)
Must be able to effectively communicate orally and in writing on business, strategy, technical, product, and solution issues and tailor to all levels of organization

People

Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and influence individuals and teams
Demonstrated ability to confidently brief senior executives and field real-time follow-up questions, virtually and in person.
Demonstrated ability to work cross-organizationally, form and nurture strong teams, and have a reputation as a collaborative team player

Personal

Demonstrated growth mindset including innate curiosity and eagerness to explore new topics and share learnings
Demonstrated ability to work in areas of high ambiguity with limited information
Demonstrated judgment to make sound business decisions and handle confidential, market-sensitive information appropriately
Energy, enthusiasm, and motivation that excites the same in others

Candidate should have an MBA or minimum 5 years of work experience in market intelligence, business intelligence, business analytics, strategy, corporate development, economics, or finance. An engineering degree (or technical equivalent) is a plus.

Santa Rosa, CA Pay Range: MIN $ 153,000.00 - MAX $ 255,000.00

Colorado Springs, CO Pay Range: MIN $ 141,000.00 - MAX $ 236,000.00

Visa Sponsorship is NOT available for this role.

Careers Privacy Statement***Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
The Business Intelligence Analyst serves as a strategic partner to business leaders by transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive operational excellence, informed decision-making, and continuous improvement across the organization. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise reporting, dashboards, and analytical solutions while collaborating with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and technical teams to deliver scalable, high-quality business intelligence capabilities.
The position combines strong analytical thinking, advanced SQL expertise, and business acumen to identify trends, solve operational challenges, and support data-driven decision-making throughout NTTA.

Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the United States immediately. This position is not available for H1-B visa sponsorship.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Essential duties and functions, pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include the following. Other related duties may be assigned.

Partner with business stakeholders, operational leaders, and subject matter experts to gather requirements, define success metrics, and deliver business intelligence and analytics solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making. Design, develop, and maintain enterprise dashboards, reports, scorecards, visualizations, and scalable analytics solutions that provide actionable insights into business performance, operational trends, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Serve as the Operations subject matter expert for MicroStrategy and promote reporting best practices, data governance standards, and self-service analytics capabilities. Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and leverage cloud-based data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Azure Synapse to support reporting and analytical initiatives. Develop and maintain reporting solutions using MicroStrategy, Power BI, and other business intelligence platforms to meet evolving business needs. Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and technology teams to ensure data integrity, consistency, and quality across reporting environments. Identify and implement opportunities to automate manual processes, improve reporting efficiency, and increase accessibility of business data across the organization. Support the full reporting lifecycle, including requirements validation, testing, deployment, production support, and issue resolution to ensure reliable delivery of reporting solutions. Utilize GitHub and established development standards to support version control, collaboration, documentation, and release management processes. Document business requirements, technical specifications, and reporting solutions; perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable improvements that enhance performance, reliability, and user experience.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Years of Experience:

Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, data engineering, or a closely related field. To include:
Developing enterprise reporting and business intelligence solutions.
Advanced SQL development and query optimization.
Cloud data warehouse technologies, including BigQuery, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse, or equivalent platforms.
Dashboard and report creating utilizing business intelligence tools such as MicroStrategy, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and visualization solutions.
Business requirements gathering, documentation, analysis, and translation into technical solutions.
GitHub and version-control best practices.
Stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration to deliver reporting and analytics solutions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Master's degree
Seven (7) or more years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or data engineering. To Include:
Tolling, transportation, public sector, or related operational environments.
Operational analytics and back-office systems within the tolling industry.
Creation of wireframes, prototypes, data models, and proof-of-concept reporting solutions.
Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or other cloud computing environments.
Enterprise reporting governance, data quality management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst Lead
jobs.description:
Mission Statement

Michigan Medicine improves the health of patients, populations and communities through excellence in education, patient care, community service, research and technology development, and through leadership activities in Michigan, nationally and internationally. Our mission is guided by our Strategic Principles and has three critical components; patient care, education and research that together enhance our contribution to society.

Job Summary

The Revenue Cycle Analytics team is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Intelligence Analyst Lead to provide advanced business intelligence expertise and lead the execution and delivery of Revenue Cycle analytics initiatives. This individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining complex BI solutions, including reports, dashboards, data analysis, and analytical tools, while also providing functional leadership in the planning, prioritization, coordination, and delivery of analytics projects.

This individual will serve a key role in translating Revenue Cycle business priorities into actionable analytics solutions and ensuring work progresses from requirements through development, testing, implementation, and completion. The position will coordinate work across Business Intelligence Analysts, Financial Analysts, Revenue Cycle subject matter experts, IT, and other stakeholders to establish priorities, manage timelines, identify dependencies, and proactively address barriers to delivery.

The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of Revenue Cycle, financial, operational, technical, and project execution experience, with demonstrated ability to work with a high degree of autonomy. Experience with Revenue Cycle processes and data, including hospital billing (HB), professional billing (PB), charges, payments, adjustments, transactions, accounts receivable, denials, write-offs, and reimbursement is highly desirable.

Experience with Epic Revenue Cycle data and analytical environments such as Clarity and Caboodle is preferred. The position provides an opportunity to serve as a senior technical and functional resource while helping establish scalable analytics practices across Revenue Cycle.

Responsibilities*

Business Intelligence Development

Serve as a technical expert in business intelligence and analytics, including report development, SQL/query development, dashboard design, data visualization, validation, and user acceptance testing of developed solutions.
Design, develop, enhance, and maintain complex Revenue Cycle reports, dashboards, data products, and analytical solutions using appropriate Business Intelligence tools.
Develop analytical solutions using data from multiple sources, including financial, operational, patient, and Revenue Cycle systems.
Analyze Revenue Cycle data related to charges, payments, adjustments, transactions, accounts receivable, denials, write-offs, reimbursement, and other financial activity.
Apply knowledge of Hospital Billing (HB) and Professional Billing (PB) processes to accurately interpret and analyze Revenue Cycle data.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance to ensure analytical solutions accurately reflect source systems and financial results.
Evaluate existing reporting and analytics to identify opportunities for standardization, automation, simplification, and improved usability.
Provide advanced technical guidance and support to BI and Financial Analysts on complex reporting and analytical solutions.

Analytics Project Leadership and Execution

Lead assigned Revenue Cycle analytics projects from initiation through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and completion.
Translate business priorities into defined project scope, deliverables, milestones, responsibilities, and target completion dates.
Develop and maintain project plans and coordinate resources, activities, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple teams.
Coordinate work across BI Analysts, Financial Analysts, Revenue Cycle subject matter experts, IT resources, vendors, and operational stakeholders.
Establish realistic timelines based on scope, complexity, available resources, dependencies, and competing priorities.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, barriers, resource constraints, and potential delays.
Facilitate project meetings and working sessions and ensure action items have clear ownership and follow-up.
Escalate issues, resource conflicts, scope changes, and timeline risks in a timely manner.
Drive projects to completion and ensure deliverables meet defined requirements and quality standards.
Coordinate testing, validation, implementation, and transition of completed analytical solutions into operational use.
Provide regular status updates regarding project progress, risks, decisions, and delivery commitments.

Analytics Portfolio Management and Prioritization

Maintain and coordinate a consolidated portfolio of Revenue Cycle analytics projects, requests, and initiatives.
Partner with Revenue Cycle Analytics leadership to organize and prioritize work based on strategic priorities, operational needs, financial impact, urgency, resource capacity, and established deadlines.
Assist in evaluating new analytics requests to determine scope, effort, priority, sequencing, and appropriate resources.
Maintain visibility into workload and capacity across BI and Financial Analysts.
Identify competing priorities, resource constraints, and dependencies that may affect delivery.
Monitor work from intake through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and completion.
Provide recommendations regarding prioritization, sequencing, scope, timelines, and resource allocation.
Identify opportunities to improve the flow of work, reduce duplicative reporting, and promote reusable and standardized analytics solutions.
Support development of a structured and scalable analytics intake and delivery process.
Provide leadership with clear visibility into project status, upcoming commitments, capacity, and delivery risks.

Revenue Cycle Analytics and Stakeholder Engagement

Partner with Revenue Cycle leaders, Finance, operational departments, IT, and other stakeholders to collect and coordinate business requirements.
Apply knowledge of Revenue Cycle operations and financial processes to translate business needs into meaningful and reliable analytics.
Understand and analyze Revenue Cycle processes including charging, billing, payment posting, adjustments, accounts receivable, denials, write-offs, reimbursement, and financial transactions.
Translate abstract business questions into analytical use cases, requirements, reports, dashboards, and other BI solutions.
Interview stakeholders to understand requirements for data, reporting, analytics, performance metrics, and data quality.
Facilitate requirements discussions and help stakeholders clarify objectives, priorities, and expected outcomes.
Serve as a liaison between operational stakeholders and technical resources.
Provide analytics support for Revenue Cycle performance improvement initiatives, operational leadership, financial analysis, and enterprise initiatives.

Quality, Standards, and Functional Leadership

Promote consistent standards for Revenue Cycle analytics, reporting definitions, data validation, documentation, and quality.
Provide functional leadership, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to BI and Financial Analysts.
Conduct or coordinate peer review, testing, reconciliation, and quality assurance of analytical products.
Develop reusable reporting approaches, documentation, templates, and best practices.
Identify opportunities to improve analytics processes, reporting standards, productivity, automation, and delivery.
Stay current with Business Intelligence technologies, Revenue Cycle analytics, Epic capabilities, automation, artificial intelligence, and emerging analytical tools.
Provide functional leadership on complex analytics initiatives without direct supervisory responsibility.
Participate in special projects and other duties supporting the strategic and operational objectives of Revenue Cycle Analytics.

Required Qualifications*

Bachelor's degree in a related field with 8+ years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence, healthcare analytics, Revenue Cycle analytics, financial analytics, or a related discipline.
Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
Demonstrated experience in Business Intelligence, data analytics, financial analytics, healthcare analytics, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience developing complex reports, dashboards, analytical solutions, or data products.
Proficient use of SQL or alternative relational database querying software to support business needs.
Advanced knowledge of data analysis and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or comparable technologies.
Demonstrated experience leading projects or complex analytical initiatives from requirements through implementation.
Demonstrated ability to establish and manage project timelines, priorities, deliverables, and dependencies.
Working knowledge of healthcare Revenue Cycle processes and data.
Understanding of financial and operational transactions, including charges, payments, adjustments, accounts receivable, and related Revenue Cycle activity.
Demonstrated proficiency in technical, problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and project execution skills.
Ability to translate abstract concepts and business requirements into technical and analytical solutions.
Ability to understand complex business and Revenue Cycle processes and identify relevant data sets.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical resources, operational leadership, and executive stakeholders.
Ability to coordinate work across multiple teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deliver work within established timelines.
Adaptability and flexibility to adjust to changing project needs and priorities.
Comfort navigating ambiguity with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach and willingness to acquire and develop new skills as needed.
Relevant combination of education and experience may be considered.

Desired Qualifications*

Experience with Epic Revenue Cycle.
Experience with Epic Clarity and/or Caboodle.
Epic Clarity Proficiency or Certification.

to join us in Pune, India

If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Operations Analyst
to join our RCM Global Operations
team. This individual will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of key processes and data, supporting our mission to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of healthcare providers.

This is a high-impact role requiring extreme attention to detail, a focus on quality, and the ability to work across different functions to maintain the highest standards. The role requires a commitment to excellence, the ability to handle ambiguity, and a passion for continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

Quality Assurance and Documentation: Conduct quality assurance checks on operational processes, ensuring that all details are correct and there are zero errors.

Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with different teams, such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Account Management, to uphold quality standards and solve emerging issues.

What You Have

Experience: 2–3 years of experience in engineering or a data analysis related technical role.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
Extreme Attention to Detail: Ability to spot discrepancies and ensure accuracy in all aspects of the role.

jobs.description:
Operations Analyst

Position Overview

The Operations Analyst is a versatile position supporting both legal and general business operations across the organization. This role is designed to act as a service-oriented partner to business units, helping them maximize the efficiency, accuracy, and productivity of their processes and reporting. Analysts collaborate closely with stakeholders, gather requirements for process and reporting buildouts or improvements, and advise on performance metrics to ensure operations run smoothly and effectively. The position offers hands-on exposure to data management, systems analysis, process optimization, and legal operations, providing an ideal platform for professionals eager to develop broad-based skills in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

Manage general operations tasks such as referral intake, service and firm transfer processes, scheduled reporting, and provide post-implementation support, escalating issues as needed.
Act as a primary contact for business units, developing relationships to understand needs, document requirements, and deliver process and reporting build-out or improvements.
Evaluate processes and system capabilities to enhance operational efficiency and support informed decision-making through relevant tools and insights.
Compile status reports, dashboards, and analytics, integrating performance metrics and reporting data to support business unit productivity.
Participate in quality improvement initiatives, including data clean-up, maintenance of reporting instructions, user acceptance testing, and development of guides and training resources.
Document workflows, procedures, and meeting outcomes, contributing to firm-wide initiatives and automation projects.
Adapt to evolving requirements and perform multiple functions to maintain effective service and consistent performance for business units.

Required Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, legal studies, finance, or related field preferred but not required)
Experience in administrative, legal operations, or data/reporting roles
Strong attention to detail, organization, and reliability in task completion
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to document processes clearly and deliver timely, accurate work independently
Basic analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint)

Preferred Qualifications

Degree in business, operations, legal studies, or a related field (Associate’s or Bachelor’s preferred)
Experience in business analytics, legal operations, financial services, or process improvement—internship or entry-level experience accepted
Hands-on proficiency with Microsoft Office and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel advanced functions, reporting/dashboard software)
Programming skills (such as SQL) and familiarity with data analysis, statistical techniques, and automation
Experience with process mapping, requirements gathering, data quality management, or workflow automation
Knowledge of cloud platforms for data storage and management
Background in the legal industry, especially lender services (foreclosure or bankruptcy), is highly desirable
Ability to apply data-driven insights to improve quality, efficiency, and performance

Core Competencies

Clarity: Understand and communicate processes, instructions, and outcomes clearly and effectively.
Accountability: Take ownership for assigned tasks, ensure timely completion, and maintain high accuracy.
Collaboration: Build positive relationships with stakeholders and work well in team settings.
Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek ways to refine processes and participate in improvement initiatives.
Analytical Thinking: Review and present data with attention to accuracy and relevance; drive actionable outcomes.
Service Orientation: Demonstrate a customer-focused mindset, aiming to exceed expectations of internal and external stakeholders.
Professional Growth: Engage in ongoing learning and development, contribute suggestions, and participate in team improvement activities.
Requirements Documentation & Process Analysis: Capable of capturing business/legal requirements and observing/optimizing processes.
Time Management: Organize work, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
Willingness to Learn: Open to acquiring new technical and legal concepts relevant to the role.

Work Environment

In-office environment (Boca Raton or as specified by firm policy), blending structured, deadline-driven legal and operational settings
Standard business hours with access to learning support, mentorship, and professional development opportunities
Collaborative culture focused on reliability, excellence, and continuous improvement

Join our team as an Operations Analyst and help drive our organization’s success while growing your career in a supportive, innovative environment. Apply today!

Robertson, Anschutz, Schneid, Crane & Partners, PLLC

is a national law firm specializing in creditors’ rights and real estate law, offering employees the opportunity to work on high-impact legal matters in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with strong growth potential. RASCP fosters a collaborative, performance-driven culture where employees are empowered to take ownership of their work, contribute to meaningful client outcomes, and continuously develop their skills within a fast-paced, evolving legal environment. Employees benefit from exposure to complex, high-impact legal matters, creating opportunities for professional growth, specialization, and long-term career development in a dynamic and essential sector of the legal industry.

With a team of over 1,100 professionals operating across 20 states, RASCP has a strong reputation for delivering innovative, efficient, and results-driven legal solutions in areas including foreclosure, bankruptcy, litigation, compliance, and real estate matters. RASCP combines the resources and reach of a large organization with a client-focused, boutique-style approach, allowing teams to provide tailored solutions while maintaining strong attorney-client relationships.

AWS is seeking a talented Sales Operations Analyst to join Israel Sales Strategy and Operations team.

Work with AWS business leaders to define and answer key business questions, then work backwards to deliver meaningful insights to streamline the decision making process.

The successful candidate will be a fast learner, proactive, detailed, structured and motivated person with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional teams to solve problems and implement new solutions. You should be passionate about creating simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems while setting high standards. Your deep operational and analytical skills, and focus on our core operational inputs will make you a critical partner to sales and sales operations leaders as you help them prioritize initiatives, identify gaps in process and performance, and remove barriers to execution.

We are looking for a candidate with a strong AI experience, who is used to building tools and agents to automate processes.

Key job responsibilities

Manage key sales support systems and processes required to meet the growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives
Partner closely with the Sales Operations Leads to set ambitious yet achievable goals for the sales organization, then put a framework in place to report, analyze and measure progress against them
Manage territories, accounts, revenue flow, and quota for the sales teams
Develop relationships and work with sales, regional sales operations, and other stakeholders to create and refine the tools and processes needed to drive productivity increases
Operate as the local focal point for the company's account management roles (including revenue routing, segmentation, exceptions, etc.)
Prepare ad hoc analysis
participate in strategic projects
Create metrics, processes and mechanisms
Own the quantitative performance analysis of our sales team, to improve Sales Excellence and productivity
Use AI tools to automate sales operations processes

Mentorship and Career Growth

5+ years of Microsoft Excel experience
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
Strong AI background building tools and agents to automate and improve processes.

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of finance, business management and sales operations experience
Experience working within a high-growth, technology company

LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

jobs.title: Research & Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Girl Guides of Canada–Guides du Canada (GGC), a national membership-based organization, empowers every girl in Guiding to discover herself and be everything she wants to be. Our mission is to be a catalyst for girls empowering girls. Together, we’re building our vision of A better world, by girls .

Girl Guides of Canada is actively seeking a Research and Data Analyst

Remote working opportunity

About This Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Research and Insights, in this role, you will play a key role in leading and supporting the measurement, tracking and analysis of GGC’s membership trends, survey results and program data. This role combines strong technical research and analytical skills with strategic judgment, curiosity and the ability to connect insights across data sources. The position translates data into clear, actionable insight stories that support evidence-informed decisions related to membership growth, retention, program evaluation and organizational learning. We are looking for a curious and strategic thinker with a strong ability to connect the dots.

In This Role You Will

Lead and support member cycle surveys, including joiner, satisfaction, exit and program surveys, by designing, building, disseminating, monitoring and analyzing surveys and preparing reporting for different stakeholders.
Apply sound research methods to gather, clean, code, analyze and interpret quantitative and qualitative data, with attention to accuracy, consistency, methodological rigour and appropriate use of data.
Synthesize patterns, themes and connections across survey results, operational data, market research and external trends to explain what the data may mean for GGC’s strategy, programs and member experience.
Monitor external trends relevant to Girl Guides of Canada, including volunteerism, youth activities, gender, social trends and non-profit sector developments, and identify implications for strategic and operational decision making.
Contribute to market research, segmentation and member insight projects that inform targeted acquisition, retention, engagement and program improvement decisions.
Partner with colleagues across departments to clarify business questions, define information needs and translate research findings into practical insights and recommendations.
Prepare clear reports, dashboards, presentations and briefing materials that communicate data findings in an accessible, visually engaging and audience-appropriate way.
Tell compelling stories grounded in evidence by connecting data points, explaining the “so what,” and highlighting opportunities, risks and recommended next steps.
Use AI-enabled tools thoughtfully and responsibly to support research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while following organizational expectations for privacy, accuracy, transparency and human review.
Identify opportunities to improve survey infrastructure, reporting processes, data quality and insight-sharing practices, and recommend practical improvements.
Provide guidance to internal teams on research design, data collection and interpretation, including helping colleagues frame questions, understand findings and use insights appropriately.
Apply organizational policies and values related to inclusivity, accessibility, privacy and respectful member communication in all research and reporting activities.

General

Adheres to all relevant policies, procedures, and practices.
Liaise with other departments as required.
Provide general, ongoing support to members/volunteers, responding to/directing inquiries and consulting with the appropriate groups and individuals to support the mission and vision of GGC.
Other duties as assigned.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the incumbent(s) of this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and activities required of the position.

Requirements

Post-secondary education in marketing, business, data analysis, psychology, sociology, research methods or other relevant discipline or equivalent work experience.
3–5 years of experience in research, data analysis, business intelligence, evaluation, market research, survey analysis or a related field, including experience independently managing components of research or insight projects.
Experience contributing to market research, audience research, segmentation, evaluation or insight projects that inform organizational decision making is an asset.
Experience designing, disseminating, analyzing and reporting on surveys, interviews, focus groups or other research activities.
Strong technical research and analytical skills, including the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data, identify patterns, assess data limitations and summarize findings accurately.
Strong strategic thinking skills, with the ability to connect insights across data sources and explain why findings matter for decisions, priorities, risks or future opportunities.
Curious, thoughtful and proactive in asking good questions, exploring ambiguity and identifying opportunities for deeper analysis or improved understanding.
Ability to create clear, visually engaging presentations, reports and dashboards that communicate data findings to non-technical audiences.
Strong storytelling skills, including the ability to move from data points to key messages, implications and recommended next steps.
Collaborative working style, with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build productive relationships and act as a trusted thought partner across teams.
Responsible and AI-conscious approach to using emerging tools, including attention to privacy, bias, accuracy, transparency, data sensitivity and appropriate human judgment.
Excellent organizational skills and demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple tasks, timelines and priorities.
Able to identify problems, flag risks or data limitations, propose practical solutions and communicate issues concisely and constructively.
Self-driven learners who can work independently, take ownership of assigned work and contribute effectively as part of a team.

Assets

Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint; experience with Power BI, survey platforms (specifically Alchemer) or AI-enabled productivity tools is an asset

Annual Hiring Range:
$65,000-$72,000

Application Deadline: October 20, 2026. Submissions without a cover letter will not be considered. Please note that GGC accepts all genders for job applications.

GGC is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. We value a recruitment and selection process that is inclusive and barrier-free, and we encourage applications from people who are racialized, Indigenous, people from the 2SLGBTQI+ community, people with disabilities and other equity seeking groups. jobs.description:
Overview

About the Role & Team

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our China Market research team, focusing on Consumer Electronics and ICT — specifically PC (desktop, notebook, workstation) and smartphone/tablet markets. This role will independently build and iterate market research frameworks, lead value-chain competitive analysis, and author strategic industry reports and whitepapers. Approximately 40-50% of time will be client-facing, driving client relationships, business development, and commercial conversion of research insights into sellable products.

What You’ll Do

Build and continuously refine a systematic market research framework for PC (desktop, notebook, workstation) and smartphone/tablet markets; lead competitive landscape analysis across chipset platforms, ODM/OEM, brands, and channels.
Author annual/quarterly industry reports, whitepapers, and thematic studies to support internal and client-side strategic decisions. Design and maintain a multi-dimensional market database integrating diverse data sources; independently develop market forecasting models (sizing, share projection, scenario analysis). Utilize Python for data processing automation and complex analytical workflows; provide quality review and methodology guidance to junior team members.
Serve as key point of contact for core clients — independently lead meetings, proposals, and deliverables (~40-50% client-facing time); drive renewals and upsells.
Partner with sales across the full new-client development cycle (needs discovery, proposal design, negotiation); translate market insights into sellable research products.
Represent the firm at industry events and in media; collaborate with global/regional research teams to ensure international standards with local relevance.

What You Bring

Master’s degree preferred in Economics, Statistics, Marketing, Electronic Information, Computer Science, or related fields
5+ years of experience in market research, industry analysis, strategy consulting, or related fields, with at least 2 years focused on PC, smartphone/tablet, or ICT sectors
Proficient in Excel (data modeling, Power Query, VBA), PowerPoint (executive-level presentations), and Python for data processing and automation
Strong business acumen with verifiable BD or business development experience; able to present complex analysis to C-level clients in both Chinese and English
Adaptable, self-driven, with strong problem-solving abilities and ability to thrive in a fast-paced research environment
~20% travel required for client visits and industry events, 100% On-site (Beijing)

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

What We Offer

Individualized Culture : An environment where you can explore new areas outside your specialty and stay engaged with work you enjoy.
Hybrid Working: Hybrid working with 4 days in office per week required.
Time-off and holidays: On top of your statutory holiday allowance and public holidays, IDC grants annually review company–wide closures on 19 August (Unplug Day) and 26 December – 1 January inclusive (Global Shutdown) and a volunteering day.
A position in a highly professional and globally respected market research and advisory firm, where initiative leading to results is rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

As a Data Analyst
, you will play a critical role in delivering outstanding work for our clients. You will work closely with senior colleagues to support the efficient delivery of projects, including data collection and preparation, contributing to model finalization, writing results, and supporting the development of other analysts.

Key Responsibilities

Working with data:
Data extraction and manipulation, data analysis and validation, batch files, programming

Undertake data extraction, manipulation, and data analysis to understand the marketplace and client context relevant to each project.
Analyse all datasets to ensure that each KPI is understood and can be explained back to the team.
Ensure that all tables, charts and other information produced by you, or others has been checked for accuracy and formatted to organization standards before passing on to senior project team.
Be responsible for data collection including preparation and sending of data requests, chasing outstanding data and querying data with clients and agencies.
Ensure that all outputs are checked for accuracy by analysts; record any checks made.
Proficiency in using Excel/SQL/Python/Pandas/Analytics Workbench to process, transform, create variables and build models. Be or be working towards expert knowledge in a selection of these tools / approaches.

Building Models:
Model building and validation, sales effects calculations, ROIs, media optimisation

Building of base models according to the project specification, incorporating all drivers of KPIs, providing rationale for variables entered, understanding coefficients and SFX.
Taking base models, oversee or build in additional improvements and progress the model towards finalisation.
Calculate sales effects throughout the project to check results and assess their correctness, i.e., does media contribution make sense? Report to project team on preliminary findings and observations
Create sales effect/ ROI workbook, ensure it is easy to follow and all links are correct.
Create response curves and optimisation spreadsheets or alternatively use available tools for budget allocation. Run scenarios required to answer client objectives.
Validate models, identify areas of weakness, suggest and test possible improvements and ensure robustness and validity.

Interpretation of results
: Result interpretation and rationale, recommendations, translation of results from analytics into actionable recommendations

Provide input into the results and implications and comment on the interpretation for future strategies.
Interpret results and understand the implications of these results to the client. Be able to explain your interpretation to the team and defend your POV
Be able to explain and justify any potential changes that need to be made to provide sensible results. Especially important when reviewing others’ outputs that you are overseeing.

Requirements

2 to 4 years experience and background in similar field. Focus is data and analytics with econometrics.
Strong expertise in Python programming language is necessary.
You are highly proficient with technology, software and can demonstrate quick grasp of programming languages.
You have a degree that demonstrates technical ability (e.g., Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, etc.)
You can work within an inclusive and diverse team to deliver fresh thinking and innovative solutions.
You interact with colleagues and with our clients in a way that strengthens our culture of inclusivity, diversity, care, growth and recognition.
You have an interest in using data and analytics to make better decisions.
You are tenacious, hardworking, curious and have a strong ability to communicate.
You demonstrate a positive desire and strong aptitude for making data informed decisions.
You can demonstrate good problem-solving skills and understanding of consumer behaviour.
You have the capacity to work and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.
You take keen interest in your own learning and development.

Key Characteristics

A successful candidate must be able to demonstrate evidence of a high degree curiosity and investigation into why things work in a particular way. This might include desk research on a particular topic or deep focus on a recent client assignment. If selected for interview, candidate must be prepared to talk on a particular topic within the realms of analytics or business questions that we typically answer that they are passionate about. Examples might be “Why is my base my base?”, “What is the long-term effect of my marketing and why?”, “Dealing with uncertainty and building in foresight”, etc.

Soft Skills

It would be of an advantage for the candidate to have experience of working/ communicating with international clients/stakeholders directly and they must have strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and manage workload independently
Open, collaborative communicator who actively supports teammates
Self-motivated with a proactive approach to developing creative and technical skills
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

This is an onsite role, and candidates should be comfortable working across different shifts as needed.

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.

jobs.title: Project/Program Manager IV
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about leading complex, high-visibility initiatives that drive meaningful business outcomes across a global organization?

Do you thrive in a collaborative, matrixed environment where you can influence stakeholders, build alignment, and turn strategy into execution?

About Our Team

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX (http://www.relx.com), a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles (https://stories.relx.com/responsible-ai-principles/index.html).

About The Role

As a strategic program leader, you will drive the successful execution of complex, high-visibility initiatives that support business priorities and operational excellence. You will work across Operations, Product, and Technology teams to align stakeholders, manage execution, and deliver measurable outcomes while navigating a fast-paced, global environment.

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end execution of Tier-1 and select Tier-2, complex, high-visibility initiatives, with accountability across scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.
Translate strategic priorities into structured, multi-quarter initiatives with clear scope, timelines, dependencies, and success metrics.
Drive execution across cross-functional teams and stakeholders including Operations, Product, and Technology, building strong working relationships that enable alignment and coordinated delivery.
Operate independently in a matrixed environment, rapidly building domain understanding to challenge assumptions and support decision-making.
Ensure initiatives meet expectations for quality, schedule, cost, and operational impact, taking corrective action as needed.
Identify, manage, and escalate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs with clear, data-informed recommendations.
Establish and maintain a single source of truth for initiative status (scope, schedule, risks, dependencies), supported by consistent execution cadence and reporting.
Facilitate decision-oriented discussions and drive disciplined follow-through to ensure commitments are met and outcomes delivered.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience in project management and program leadership in operations workstreams, organizational transformation, continuous improvement, and technology contexts.
Demonstrated ability to build trust quickly, establish credibility, and motivate teams to deliver through influence rather than authority.
Demonstrated experience independently leading large-scale, complex, cross-functional initiatives in a global, matrixed organization.
Strong business judgment with the ability to operate across operational, strategic, and technology-enabled work.
Demonstrated ability to engage and influence stakeholders, including senior leaders, and drive alignment through strong relationships and credibility in a global environment.
Proven ability to manage scope, schedule, risk, and quality while maintaining execution discipline and visibility.
Demonstrated ability to drive follow-through and deliver outcomes in complex, fast-moving environments.
Proficiency with program and project management tools (e.g., monday.com, Azure DevOps or similar), Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and generative AI/LLM tools to support productivity and business outcomes.
5+ years of relevant experience leading project teams or coordinating cross-functional work; experience in or exposure to enterprise PMO environments is a plus.
PMP and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher; MBA or JD preferred
Possible travel up to 10%.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About The Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

Primary Location Base Pay Range: Colorado Springs, CO $78,800 - $131,300. This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus. Application deadline is 02/15/2027.

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

We are seeking a Senior IT Project Manager
or Manager for the IT Program Management Office
. You will own delivery across our program portfolio, and you will own the team: how work is taken in and prioritized, how programs are planned and tracked, how risk surfaces early, and how program managers grow.

Program Delivery
Own delivery across the portfolio: scope, schedule, dependencies, and risk across programs.
Surface risks early with a recommendation, not just a flag. Drive resolution rather than reporting status.

Intake and Prioritization
Partner with business analysts and engineering to convert stated requests into validated requirements before build.
Model capacity and hold the prioritization line across new development, optimization, and support.

Process Management
Own PMO standards: planning artifacts, work breakdown discipline, status reporting, and work management platform hygiene.
Own the executive reporting pipeline, including status calibration and escalation criteria.
Identify and fix process gaps without being asked. Own portfolio metrics and report them monthly.

Day-to-Day Management
Lead a team of program and project managers across junior, intermediate, and senior levels.
Set priorities, assign programs to the right level of PM, and hold delivery commitments.
Resolve cross-functional conflict at your level. Escalate patterns, not incidents.

Coaching and Performance
Coach program managers toward independence, including the judgment to deviate from plan when conditions change.
Build a team that identifies problems and solves them rather than waiting for direction.

Qualifications

7+ years in technical program or project management, including three or more years directly managing five or more program managers.
You have run a portfolio of concurrent software delivery programs, not one project at a time.

Requestors can submit requests with information such as the nature of the project, project name, and request date.

Experience with projects involving SOC 2.
Experience working with external audit and assurance stakeholders.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the successful delivery of new and remodel of dariy construction projects. This role ensures projects are executed safely, profitably, on time, and within defined scope and quality standards. The position focuses on tactical project execution, project team leadership, client communication, subcontractor coordination, and overall project profitability while supporting operational consistency and company standards. The Senior Project Manager also maintains strong oversight of project performance and ensures full compliance with company, safety, and regulatory requirements.

This position does require travel to our job sites.

Lead and manage new and remodel construction projects from initiation through completion.
Oversee project schedules, budgets, timelines, project tracking, billing, work in progress reporting, subcontractor coordination, staffing, material planning, and overall project execution.
Support Account Managers in defining project scope and assist Project Managers and Jobsite Superintendents with leadership, communication, issue resolution, and project execution.
Review estimates, buyout documentation, contracts, permits, specifications, and project scopes prior to project startup.
Develop, maintain, and monitor project schedules, tracking systems, Gantt charts, and internal reporting processes.
Manage project documentation, contracts, and reporting systems to ensure accurate and timely records.
Monitor project performance against scope, budget, schedule, profitability, quality, and company standards.
Ensure compliance with OSHA, insurance, customer, contract, and company requirements.
Lead issue resolution efforts related to project execution, scheduling conflicts, subcontractor performance, and customer concerns.
Coordinate with Accounting, Purchasing, and Operations teams to support project execution and financial reporting.
Support quality control, risk management, operational consistency, and successful project delivery.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.
Provide project updates and reporting to leadership while supporting continuous improvement and best practices across teams.
All other duties assigned.

Skills And Abilities

Ability to lead and support Project Managers and Jobsite Superintendents across multiple projects.
Demonstrate strong leadership, accountability, professionalism, and communication skills.
Maintain focus on tactical project delivery, operational consistency, and customer satisfaction.
Work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with diverse groups.
Strong ability to schedule, multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Maintain a high level of organization, attention to detail, and project management accuracy.
Manage large-scale, complex construction projects while supporting quality, safety, and compliance standards.
Apply strong financial, analytical, and problem-solving skills to support project performance and profitability.
Maintain professional written and verbal communication with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.
Support company safety initiatives and reinforce OSHA, customer, and company compliance.
Drive accountability for project-level performance, execution standards, and overall project success.

5+ years of experience in construction project management, exceeding $5M in revenue, with experience leading multiple projects.
Strong knowledge of construction processes, scheduling, budgeting, subcontractor management, and project financials.
Professional Engineer license preferred, or ability to obtain.
Agricultural construction experience, particularly swine and/or dairy, is preferred.
Proficiency in engineering and construction management practices, project management software, Microsoft Office, and construction reporting systems.

Experience operating or working around common construction equipment and tools, including telehandlers, skid loaders, hand and power tools, and PPE.
Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
