jobs.title: Legal Program Manager, Launch Readiness
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Legal Operations designs and operates the systems, workflows, and programs that help Stripe’s Legal organization work effectively at scale. The team partners with Legal practices, Product, Engineering, Sales, and other cross-functional teams to deliver durable operational and technical solutions.

What you’ll do

As a Legal Program Manager supporting Launch Readiness, you will manage contracting-system and workflow changes required for new products, commercial offerings, and other business launches. You will translate launch and Legal-practice needs into clear delivery plans, coordinate work across legal subject-matter experts and technical partners, and guide changes through design, testing, release, and stabilization. Your work will involve contract templates, approval workflows, intake processes, reporting, automation, and integrations across systems like Ironclad, Salesforce, Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) tools, and other internal contracting tools. You will own the operational delivery of assigned contracting-system initiatives while partnering with technical specialists and engineers on implementation. You will also help establish reusable patterns, documentation, and controls that make future changes safer and more scalable.

Responsibilities

Manage contracting-system and workflow initiatives supporting product launches and monetized offerings, translating business and legal requirements into clear scope, milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
Coordinate cross-functional delivery across Product Operations, Legal, Product, Engineering, Sales, Deal Management, and other stakeholders, aligning system changes with broader launch plans and decision dates.
Lead changes to contract templates, intake forms, questionnaires, approvals, reporting, automations, and related workflows from design and configuration through testing, deployment, and post-launch stabilization.
Assess downstream impacts on contract output, approvals, integrations, data and access controls, reporting, and user experience.
Maintain visibility into delivery status, dependencies, decisions, risks, and blockers, escalating launch-critical issues with clear impact assessments, options, and recommendations.
Confirm that testing, release documentation, rollback and support plans, and other readiness evidence are complete before production changes are made.
Develop repeatable intake, testing, release, documentation, and change-management practices, including approved patterns and controls that enable safe self-service for appropriate low-risk changes.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve system reliability, address technical debt, and create reusable solutions across Legal practices.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Legal Studies, Business or a related field.
5+ years of experience in program management, legal operations, business systems, product operations, implementation, or a related field.
Experience managing cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and fixed delivery dates.
Experience translating business needs into structured requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
Familiarity with contract lifecycle management, commercial contracting, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software, workflow, or enterprise business systems.
Experience coordinating testing, change management, production releases, or implementation readiness.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $133,200 - $199,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Privia Health™ is a technology-driven, national physician enablement company that collaborates with medical groups, health plans, and health systems to optimize physician practices, improve patient experiences, and reward doctors for delivering high-value care in both in-person and virtual settings. The Privia Platform is led by top industry talent and exceptional physician leadership, and consists of scalable operations and end-to-end, cloud-based technology that reduces unnecessary healthcare costs, achieves better outcomes, and improves the health of patients and the well-being of providers.

Job Description

The Technical Project Manager is a key member of the Project Management Office (PMO) team. This role manages key projects and drives process improvement across Privia teams. The Technical Project Manager partners with members of product and technical teams to deliver project and programmatic outcomes. The Technical Project Manager will plan, execute, close out, and monitor projects - all while escalating risks, blockers, and issues. This role emphasizes supporting technical teams, drives project execution and aligning their portfolio of projects to high priority technical roadmaps. This role will partner closely with Product teams to ensure successful execution of project and measurable outcomes.

Essential Job Duties

Lead, coordinate, and manage activity between Privia technical and non-technical team stakeholders.
Directly manage multiple projects simultaneously, and assist in a portfolio of projects owned by Associates & others around Privia.
Create and manage detailed project plans and communicate status to the project sponsors, management teams, and leaders at every level of the organization.
Prepare and distribute project artifacts, including delivery/project plans, success metrics/KPIs.
Assist in the development and implementation of project & technical quality assurance processes.
Act as a bridge between technical and business teams, ensuring alignment on project priorities.
Leverage Privia and PMO ROI models for technical projects.
Coordinate tracking and communicating the progress of AI projects through existing AI governance channels, ensuring alignment with organizational standards and business objectives.
Leverage a deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle in order to foster effective project execution.

Interpersonal Skills & Attributes

Ability to perform a variety of duties and demonstrate organizational skills from planning to execution of tasks and projects
Team approach to working with others and solving complex problems through collaboration
Ability to identify & escalate risks
Effectively manage meetings and conversations with a diverse group of internal & external stakeholders
Exceptional organizational skills & attention to detail
Process oriented with the ability to drive a project to completion
Self-directed and resourceful with a bias towards action
Strong background in conducting gap analysis, process optimization, and implementing governance structures.
Proven ability to work collaboratively across technical, clinical, and operational teams to achieve business goals.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn business requirements into actionable solutions.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience
5+ years of technical project management experience
1+ years of remote work experience
Proficiency with project management tools preferred (e.g. Monday.com, Smartsheet, JIRA)

Experience with ROI modeling and forecasting of technical projects
Familiarity with tech sprint cycles, IT release management and AI/automation initiatives
Experience using scrum and Kanban methodology

jobs.description:
About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

About The Role

You will be Fin's first dedicated compliance operations hire, running the day-to-day engine of our compliance program. You report to the Head of Compliance.

Our compliance framework is in place: a Board-approved Compliance Charter, core programs for sanctions and financial crime, due diligence, fraud, complaints, third-party risk and records management, and a modern tooling stack. What we need now is someone who makes it run, every day, at the speed our customers move money.

This is a hands-on role. You will review real businesses, work real alerts, and help turn manual processes into automated, auditable workflows alongside engineering. Payment volume is growing quickly, and this role is how compliance capacity keeps pace.

What you'll do

Business onboarding and due diligence

Own the KYB/CDD review queue: use our tooling to verify legal entity, formation and DBA records, registered and operating addresses, website and commercial footprint, beneficial owners (25%+) and control persons.
Manage customer risk rating process, and run enhanced due diligence on higher-risk profiles such as complex ownership, PEP exposure, high-risk industries or FATF-monitored jurisdictions.
Issue and track RFIs, judge whether responses actually resolve the gap, and write clear disposition memos, including decline and exit recommendations.

Sanctions and blockchain screening

Disposition sanctions, PEP and adverse media matches for entities and associated persons, with documented rationale.
Triage blockchain analytics alerts on inbound and outbound transfers, and run hold-and-review workflows for flagged funds as pre-transaction interdiction comes online.

Partner, audit and program readiness

Answer partner due diligence and information requests accurately and on time, and deliver against our partner reporting calendar.
Write and maintain the procedures and runbooks that sit under our compliance programs.

Process and automation

Track and report operating metrics such as queue age, review turnaround, alert volumes, RFI aging and override rates.
Spot recurring manual work and turn it into a tooling or workflow fix.

What you bring

1-4+ years in compliance operations at a fintech, payments company, crypto business or bank, with direct ownership of AML, KYB/CDD and/or EDD reviews.
Strong business due diligence skills: you can untangle multi-layer ownership, read formation documents and registry records, and tell when a business's story does not add up.
Experience investigating unusual activity and writing referrals or case narratives that another compliance team could act on without follow-up questions.
Working knowledge of the BSA/AML framework, FinCEN guidance and FATF standards as they apply to payments and digital assets.
Clear, precise writing. Your memos and RFIs hold up to partner, auditor and examiner review.

Nice to have

CAMS, CAMS-FCI, CCI, CRCM or a similar certification.
Experience with trade-based money laundering typologies or with wholesale, trading or import/export customers.
Hands-on experience dispositioning sanctions, PEP and adverse media alerts, with a working knowledge of OFAC requirements.
Experience with Persona, Middesk or similar KYB and case management platforms.
Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools (such as Chainalysis or TRM) and with how stablecoin flows move on-chain.

Compensation Range: $70K - $100K

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve.

Position Summary

Empower is hiring a dedicated, operations-focused Project Manager to drive infrastructure development, planning discipline, and cross-functional coordination across a portfolio of priorities within the EBP (evidence-based practice) division. This role blends classic project management fundamentals — planning, scheduling, risk management, budget and resource tracking, and performance reporting — with hands-on operational work: consolidating fragmented workflows into unified processes, project managing organizational transitions, designing and documenting scalable practices and processes, and project managing the development of new products and resources within Empower’s clinical models.

A key part of this role is partnering directly with leadership, including the C-suite and other executives, to translate strategic priorities into concrete operational plans and to drive those plans through execution. Fluency with automation and AI tools is a foundational requirement for this role, expected to be applied across process design, reporting, and day-to-day operational work.

Success depends on close, ongoing collaboration with all other functional areas — including Clinical, Finance, Technology, HR, and Sales & Marketing — to ensure operational changes are clinically sound, financially sustainable, well-positioned both internally and externally, and competently executed. Beyond these core priorities, this person will also serve as a utility resource for general process improvement and automation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Executive Partnership: Collaborate with organizational leaders to translate strategic priorities into structured, actionable operational plans. Provide regular progress updates, risk assessments, and recommendations to leadership to support decision-making, and help leadership teams think through sequencing and trade-offs as plans evolve

Product & Resource Development (Clinical Models): Project manage the development of new products and resources within Empower’s clinical models — such as new curricula, training materials, or program resources — coordinating across Clinical, Technology, and other stakeholders from concept through launch
Performance Measurement & Reporting: Define success metrics and KPIs for key initiatives, and build and maintain status reports and dashboards that keep stakeholders and leadership aligned on progress, risks, and outcomes
Resource & Budget Coordination: Support budget tracking, resource allocation, and vendor or contract coordination across initiatives, partnering with Finance to ensure operational plans remain financially sustainable
Continuous Improvement: Serve as a utility resource for general process improvement and automation across the division, supporting Empower’s broader move toward integrated, One Empower operations

new_jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

About The Role

Horizon3.ai is building a Strategy & Programs function within Revenue Operations to help the organization successfully execute its highest-priority cross-functional initiatives as we continue to scale.

We are looking for a RevOps Program Manager to lead complex initiatives that span Revenue Operations and the broader business. This role will partner closely with teams including Sales Operations, Systems Operations, Deal Desk, Customer Operations, Partner Operations, Finance, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

This is not a traditional IT Project Manager role, nor is it a project coordinator position. The ideal candidate combines strong program management discipline with business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to create structure in ambiguous environments.

You will be responsible for turning strategic priorities into executable plans, aligning stakeholders around decisions and outcomes, identifying and managing risks and dependencies, and driving initiatives from definition through implementation.

As an early member of the Strategy & Programs team, you will also have the opportunity to help establish how project management operates within Revenue Operations as the function grows.

What You'll Do

Lead Strategic Initiatives

Lead moderately complex, cross-functional initiatives from initial scoping through implementation and closeout with little to no day-to-day direction.
Translate strategic priorities and business objectives into clear project plans, milestones, workstreams, dependencies, and success measures.
Establish appropriate project governance, operating cadences, decision-making structures, and stakeholder engagement models.
Manage multiple concurrent initiatives across different areas of the Revenue Operations organization.
Maintain accountability across project teams while recognizing that functional leaders and subject-matter experts retain ownership of functional decisions and outcomes.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

Coordinate work across Revenue Operations functions including Sales Operations, Systems Operations, Deal Desk, Customer Operations, and Partner Operations, as well as teams across the broader organization.
Facilitate effective working sessions, project meetings, leadership reviews, and decision-making forums.
Proactively identify dependencies, risks, blockers, and competing priorities and drive them toward resolution.
Establish clear owners, decisions, and next steps across project workstreams.
Escalate issues appropriately when additional leadership direction or decision-making is required.
Build alignment across teams with different priorities, perspectives, and areas of expertise.

Provide Project Governance & Visibility

Maintain project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and action items.
Develop concise, executive-ready project updates that communicate progress, risks, decisions required, and overall project health.
Ensure leadership has appropriate visibility into strategic initiatives without creating unnecessary administrative overhead.
Support portfolio-level visibility across active Strategy & Programs initiatives.
Help establish repeatable project management standards, templates, and governance practices for the organization.

Support Business & Operational Transformation

Projects May Include Initiatives Such As

Sales process and operating model changes
Territory, segmentation, and coverage initiatives
Pricing and packaging rollouts
Partner and channel program launches
Customer lifecycle improvements
Quote-to-Cash transformation
Revenue technology implementations
CRM and GTM systems initiatives
Systems integrations and automation
New GTM motions and commercialization programs
Data and reporting initiatives
Process redesign and operational scalability initiatives

The specific portfolio will evolve based on business priorities. Program Managers are expected to operate across both business-oriented and technology-enabled initiatives rather than being permanently assigned to a single Revenue Operations function.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of project, program, business operations, Revenue Operations, or related experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage moderately complex projects from scoping through implementation.
Experience working in a high-growth SaaS, technology, or similarly fast-paced environment.
Strong project planning, organization, prioritization, and risk-management skills.
Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar business processes and operating models.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than formal authority.
Experience coordinating stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of an organization.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating project status, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders.
Ability to identify problems, evaluate tradeoffs, exercise sound judgment, and drive teams toward practical solutions.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where processes or requirements may not yet be fully defined.
Ability to balance project management rigor with the speed and pragmatism required in a high-growth environment.

Experience That Could Make You Successful

We expect successful candidates to come from a variety of backgrounds. Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable:

Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, Partner Operations, Deal Desk, or Business Operations
Cross-functional GTM initiatives or commercial transformation
Business systems or revenue technology implementations
CRM, CPQ, CLM, ERP, or other enterprise technology programs
Product or Engineering partnership
Process improvement and operating model design
Change management and organizational transformation
Data, analytics, or data governance initiatives

What Success Looks Like

Successful Program Managers within Strategy & Programs:

Turn ambiguous business priorities into clear, executable plans.
Create accountability without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
Anticipate risks and dependencies rather than simply reporting them after they occur.
Drive timely decisions and maintain momentum across cross-functional teams.
Build trust with both business and technical stakeholders.
Give leaders clear visibility into project health, tradeoffs, and decisions required.
Help initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes while ensuring sustainable transition to the appropriate functional owners.
Continuously improve how Revenue Operations plans and delivers complex initiatives.

Who You Are

You are highly organized without being overly process-driven. You are comfortable walking into an initiative where not everything has been figured out yet and helping the team establish a path forward.

You ask good questions, learn unfamiliar areas quickly, and understand when to facilitate, when to challenge, and when to escalate. You are equally comfortable working with detailed project teams and communicating with senior leadership.

Most importantly, you view program management as more than maintaining timelines and scheduling meetings. You see the role as helping teams turn complex business decisions into coordinated, measurable execution.

Perks of Horizon3

Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.
Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.
Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.
Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation And Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

Base salary range: $145,000 - $160,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.
Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a Project Manager to help us support and expand our solid waste and environmental engineering practice. You will lead engineering, environmental, and consulting projects in the coal-fired power, industrial, and municipal solid waste sectors. This role will involve managing multidisciplinary engineering projects associated with solid waste management facilities. We will value both your ability to mentor your internal team members and your active participation in client and business development. The successful candidate will collaborate with clients and our engineers, scientists, and support staff to deliver projects associated with design, construction, environmental monitoring, remediation, and permitting of solid waste facilities. This position provides a strong pathway to technical leadership, client management, and business development with a rapidly growing and successful company. You may work hybrid out of our Madison office. Remote work may be considered for the ideal candidate.

How You Can Make An Impact

Project Management

Manage engineering projects from conceptual planning through design, permitting, bidding, and construction support.
Develop and manage project scopes, schedules, budgets, and project teams.
Coordinate multidisciplinary staff including civil, geotechnical, environmental, and construction professionals.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, regulatory agencies, and contractors.
Participate in client development

Team Leadership

Mentor junior engineers and technical staff.
Support staff development, training, and project execution.

Engineering & Technical Responsibilities

Lead engineering design and analysis for solid waste projects, including:
Groundwater remediation systems
Landfill cells, expansions, and closures.
Leachate collection systems
Landfill gas collection and control systems
Storm water management systems
Grading and site development plans
Transfer station permit modifications
Prepare and review:
Engineering calculations
Technical reports
Permit applications
Construction drawings and specifications
Cost estimates and engineering studies
Perform coordination and provide support during construction and construction quality assurance (CQA) activities.

Regulatory and Compliance Support

Be knowledgeable on regulatory permitting and compliance with:
Federal coal combustion residual (CCR) regulations
State solid waste and environmental regulations
Air permitting related to landfill gas systems
Storm water and water quality systems
Coordinate with local and state regulatory agencies during permit review and approvals.

Business Development and Client Relations

Lead preparation of technical proposals, scopes, and cost estimates.
Participate in client meetings, industry conferences, and professional organizations.
Identify and deliver opportunities to expand services with existing clients.
Plan, coordinate, and develop new client relationships in our industry.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Geological/Geotechnical, or Environmental Engineering required.
Minimum 8 years of professional engineering experience required, preferably in solid waste or environmental consulting required.
Professional registration (e.g., P.E.) preferred
Demonstrated experience with remediation and solid waste infrastructure projects required.
Strong project management and organizational skills required.
Experience directing staff using AutoCAD and AutoCAD Civil3D design software preferred.
Valid driver’s license and driving record in good standing required.

Convoso is a leading AI-powered contact center platform purpose-built for revenue teams. Since 2006, Convoso has remained at the forefront of innovation, consistently developing solutions to drive customer growth while supporting adherence to regulatory standards.

Who We Are:

While headquartered in Los Angeles, the Convoso team can be found around the globe working in either a hybrid or remote capacity. Awarded as a "best place to work" company, our culture fosters team integrity, positive persistence, and continuous growth.

Our core platform powers successful sales teams across multiple industries, giving our customers a competitive edge and streamlined productivity. With built-in Al and automations, our product is a premium offering in a competitive space. We continue to grow our product capabilities to better serve our current customers and to expand into newer markets.

Convoso is looking for people who are excited about technology and innovation. We are a company of motivated team players with diverse backgrounds driving accelerated growth in a supportive, positive culture.

Most roles at Convoso function as “hybrid” with some opportunities for travel to in-person business events and company meetings. For remote positions, Convoso’s U.S. hiring is open to candidates residing anywhere within the United States.

The Job:

The Implementation Manager will be the primary POC post sale, ensuring timely client discovery, account setup, training, and launch support. High-energy, organized individual to join our team as an Implementation Manager. This position entails client servicing, identifying their challenges, and providing solutions that help solve those challenges while driving revenue growth. The ideal candidate should have experience with SaaS technology and experience with call center environments. The position requires the ability to multi-task between various softwares, client relationships, while communicating with a sense of urgency. Our Implementation team is very supportive of each other however, being able to work independently is key to the team’s success as a whole.

Responsibilities summary:

Installation, integration and deployment of Convoso SaaS products in client environments.
Train customers on how to effectively utilize the dialer software as both administrators and agents, ensuring confident, independent platform use.
Focus on improving onboarding efficiency, customer satisfaction and initial product adoption.
Communicating to clients and partners aspects of both the product and the implementation at the technical and/or functional level appropriate for the situation.
Anticipating client’s needs, mapping a timeline, and managing their expectations during the implementation process.
Managing technical aspects of a delivery end-to-end with minimal escalation.
Managing controlled soft launches to specific end users for testing, fine tuning/optimization based on client needs.
Effectively coordinate client handoffs from our Customer Success team and initial reception of clients from our Sales team.
Foster innovation and be the voice of the customer implementation internally at Convoso by sharing best practices.

Who You Are:

1-3 years of experience in Implementation, Account Management, Customer Success in the SaaS industry or similar.
Experience in managing a high volume of projects with cross-functional teams.
Experience interfacing with customers in the B2C space.
Ability to identify solutions for customers while upselling products and services.
Experience developing and advising solutions to hit revenue targets during the implementation stages.
Excellent project management skills and focused methodology mindset for success during all implementation phases.
Previous experience in the call center space is preferred.
Understand simple API integrations, customizations and simple SQL queries.
Past Java Scripting experience or exposure is nice to have however, not required.
Passion for implementation, Day Zero initiatives, in a supportive and creative work environment.
Experience with onboarding, education, set up of software, data transfers, etc.
Proficiency in Google Suite and Salesforce, as well as familiarity with Zendesk and Vitally or similar customer success platforms.
Stellar problem-solving skills and enjoy providing a high level of service.
Experience w/simple SQL queries.
Willingness to take initiative individually and within a team.

Work Perks Worth The Hype:

Competitive compensation package
Stock options
100% covered premiums for employees; Medical, Dental, Basic life insurance, Long term disability
Affordable Vision plan and optional FSA
PTO, Paid Sick Time, Holidays, Bereavement time, Parental Leave
Your birthday off
401k program with generous company match
No cost Employee Assistance Program and Travel Assistance
Monthly Gym membership reimbursement
Monthly credits toward food & beverage
Company Outings
On and offsite team building events
Paid training for departments
Apple laptop (most roles)
And a team of highly experienced and kind colleagues!
HQ Office:
Casual office environment & dress
Daily catered lunches
Fully stocked kitchen (Dietary restriction-friendly)
Happy Hours
On-site Car Wash
Free Parking

Compensation:

The base salary range is: $75,000 - $85,000

new_jobs.title: ERP Sr. Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Infleqtion is seeking an ERP Sr. Program Manager to lead enterprise resource planning (ERP) programs and improvements across finance and operations. This role will turn business priorities into clear requirements, coordinated delivery plans and reliable system capabilities, working closely with business process owners, application teams and implementation partners.

The ERP Sr. Program Manager will own program delivery from discovery and planning through testing, deployment, adoption and transition to support. The ideal candidate combines strong ERP process knowledge with disciplined program management, practical controls awareness and the ability to coordinate detailed work across business and technical teams. This role will operate within enterprise portfolio priorities and the common software development lifecycle (SDLC) framework.

Key Responsibilities

ERP Planning and Program Delivery

Develop and maintain the ERP program roadmap and delivery plans with business sponsors and application leadership, aligning proposed initiatives with enterprise priorities and available capacity
Lead ERP implementations, enhancements, integrations, upgrades and process improvements from initial scoping through stabilization and operational handover, including connections to CRM and other business applications that support customer data, orders and billing
Define program scope, outcomes, milestones, resource needs and budgets; manage interdependent workstreams and cross-functional delivery risks, and hold implementation partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and knowledge transfer
Translate business needs into documented requirements and acceptance criteria across finance, accounts payable, procurement, inventory, manufacturing and order management
Facilitate process and solution decisions with the appropriate business and technical owners; document tradeoffs and escalate accounting, architecture, security or policy decisions to accountable leaders
Maintain clear plans, decision logs, issue and risk registers, change requests and status reporting; bring sponsors timely recommendations when scope, cost or delivery dates are at risk

Testing, Controls and Deployment

Coordinate the full SDLC, including requirements, solution design, configuration or development, integration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness and deployment
Lead user acceptance testing and quality assurance (UAT/QA) planning with business users and technical teams, ensuring realistic scenarios, documented expected and actual results, defect ownership, remediation, retesting and sign-off
Embed practical change management, role-based access and segregation-of-duties considerations into ERP delivery in partnership with finance, security and control owners
Ensure changes follow established authorization and evidence requirements, with appropriate review of elevated access, configuration changes and release readiness
Coordinate data migration, cleansing, validation and reconciliation with data and process owners, including clear acceptance criteria for integrations and converted records
Manage cutover, contingency and post-deployment support plans; verify operational readiness and track issues through stabilization

Business Adoption and Continuous Improvement

Lead change, communication and training plans grounded in real business scenarios, user responsibilities, system functionality and relevant controls; coordinate effective materials and sessions with business and technical owners
Partner with support teams to identify recurring issues, translate improvement opportunities into the ERP backlog and protect capacity for critical operational needs
Ensure new capabilities have documented support ownership, procedures and escalation paths before handover
Track adoption, process performance and program outcomes with business owners; apply lessons learned to improve subsequent releases
Contribute ERP delivery practices, templates and reporting to the PMO and use the common demand-intake, prioritization and governance processes

Description

ABOUT US

Interfaith America is a national nonprofit organization based in Chicago. We believe that religious diversity is a foundational American strength, and we are building a nation that achieves that promise for the common good. Our mission is to inspire, equip, and connect organizations and leaders to unlock the potential of America’s religious diversity. We leverage our expertise in interfaith leadership in different sectors and spaces in American life, such as higher education, health, public policy, racial equity, corporations/business, tech – giving leaders and institutions the tools and resources they need to positively engage religious diversity for the common good.

At Interfaith America, we are ever adapting and changing. We look for people who set audacious goals and love that one workday may not be like the next. We have a strong commitment to pluralism and building bridges across deep differences. Our programs help people build skills to bridge deep ideological divides. Our work is about staying in relationship with one another and contributing to the common good even when we might disagree on fundamental things. We seek to attract and retain a team of staff comprised of a wide variety of views and backgrounds we need to achieve our vision, especially people from communities historically underrepresented in interfaith work.

THIS POSITION

Interfaith America has worked with American colleges and universities for over twenty years. We are committed to providing high-quality programming that suffuses and sustains higher education’s commitment to engaging religious diversity and advances a culture of pluralism more broadly on campuses. The Program Manager (Campus Partnerships) is an essential part of the Campus Partnerships team within IA’s Higher Education sector. While all IA program managers engage religious and worldview diversity with a variety of constituents, this position will specifically focus on worldview diversity, interfaith cooperation, and civic pluralism within postsecondary contexts. This position will require close collaboration with external campus partners, including senior-level leadership such as university presidents, chancellors, and senior administrators. Additionally, responsibilities may involve close collaboration with external partners, such as academic associations and nonprofit organizations, to facilitate IA’s campus work.

Responsibilities

Work with the Director of Campus Partnerships to manage comprehensive on-campus consultation projects to support campuses in developing a pluralism strategy Deploy Interfaith America programs and theories of civic and interfaith cooperation when working on projects involving university presidents, chancellors, senior administrators, and other campus constituencies
Execute pieces of work on Interfaith America projects, including data tracking in line with project goals and impact; CRM responsibilities; and administrative tasks
Lead event planning and execution for IA’s higher education conferences pertaining to university presidents, chancellors, and senior administrators, in collaboration with other IA staff members and external vendors
Coordinate and contribute to IA strategies and initiatives focused on HBCU institutions
Cultivate relationships with civic partners (e.g. peers at non-profits), academic associations, and campus constituents
Develop and facilitate in-person and virtual trainings for campus partners
Manage assigned Interfaith America programs and grants, including overseeing grant or program design, outreach, programming, evaluation, and finances (budgets, payments, etc.)
Represent Interfaith America through presentations and attendance at conferences, on campus visits, and at IA events
Coordinate and contribute to key elements of the Higher Education Student Affairs (HESA) Fellowship, including virtual gatherings, and elective writing and thought leadership opportunities for fellows
Support broader HESA Faculty Fellowship priorities such as the promotion, planning, and execution of the annual in-person convening
Contribute to other projects within IA’s Higher Education team as assigned

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

A bachelor’s degree
3–5 years of professional experience in a related field, including higher education, student affairs, interfaith work, consulting, etc.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills
Ability to balance and prioritize multiple ongoing projects from multiple stakeholders
Ability to meet deadlines and work well under pressure
Strong attention to detail
Strong competence in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
Proven project management and organizational skills
Demonstrated effectiveness in interfacing with multiple constituencies, such as non-profit partners; campus administrators, faculty, staff or students
Authorization to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications (not Required)

Advanced degree in Higher Education, Civic Leadership, Religious Studies, Nonprofit Management, or Project Management
Experience in in-person and online training, facilitation, consulting, education, and/or related skill sets
Experience with higher education or non-profit evaluation and assessment
Demonstrated ability to engage stakeholders in substantive discussions about religious and worldview diversity, interfaith cooperation, and civic pluralism
Experience developing and implementing strategies with an “engaging deep differences” approach to diversity work within higher education
Experience with networking and building relationships or coalitions within higher education

Location: This position will work 2-3 days per week from our Chicago Loop office and 2-3 days per week from home

Travel: Approximately 15–20% of work time will be traveling to colleges/universities, and conferences across the country (average throughout year; may be more during peak academic and conference seasons); can expect to work occasional nights and weekends

Supervision: Director of Campus Partnerships

Salary: $70,000-$80,000

Key Responsibilities

Leadership Alignment: Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to establish goals, metrics, and decision frameworks.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Align Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Capacity, Data, Finance, Ops, and Security teams.
Decision Management: Identify tradeoffs early, document decisions, and manage escalations to resolution.
Customer Representation: Represent internal technical users and integrate their workflows into program planning.

Infrastructure Efficiency

Utilization Insights: Establish fleet-wide reporting for resource usage (CPU, bandwidth, memory, storage I/O, and RPS) to inform capacity planning and cost-efficiency strategies. Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale.
Strategic Alignment: Coordinate shared dependencies across Infrastructure Engineering, Capacity Planning, Traffic Engineering, and Network Infrastructure workstreams where resource management and tracking intersect.

Engineering Reliability

Program Ownership: Lead end-to-end chaos engineering, from test planning and execution to results publication.
Execution & Readiness: Coordinate readiness reviews, go/no-go decisions, and safe execution of production resilience tests.
Tracking & Reporting: Track remediation, evaluate program impact, and maintain roadmaps, dashboards, and runbooks.

Desirable Skills And Knowledge

BS+ in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of technical program management experience, preferably in infrastructure, reliability, performance, data platforms, distributed systems, or large-scale engineering environments.
Strong technical fluency with infrastructure systems, telemetry/observability, reliability practices (SLO/SLIs), capacity planning, data pipelines, traffic management, progressive rollouts, or blast-radius reduction.
Proven experience partnering with Product and Engineering to clarify vision, represent internal customer workflows, define use cases, prioritize requirements, and measure success.
Ability to create realistic project plans, manage dependencies, and oversee execution to meet commitments and deliver with predictability.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor technical complexity for diverse audiences, from engineering teams to executive leadership.
Experience working across multiple time zones and multiple cross-functional teams.
Fluent with Confluence, Jira, dashboards, and project planning tools.
Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output
Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity
Experience with various development and delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Kaizen, Scrum, or hybrid approaches).
Ability to bring structure to ambiguity, act as a self-starter, and drive issues to resolution with empathy and sound judgment.

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo

The role integrates hardware, software, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, finance, safety, service, and external partners to deliver the complete vehicle to timing, cost, quality, performance, and regulatory targets. Program Leadership

Support the execution of the integrated vehicle program plan, including schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and readiness criteria.
Drive cross-functional execution against timing, cost, quality, technical, and launch objectives.
Lead program reviews, maintain objective program health reporting, and coordinate recovery plans where delivery is at risk.
Assess scope and change impacts and support timely, data-driven program decisions.

Vehicle-Level Technical Integration

Develop a strong working understanding of vehicle architecture, requirements, attributes, and technical deliverables.
Partner with Chief Engineering and functional teams to align hardware and software development at the vehicle level.
Facilitate technical trade-off and issue-resolution discussions, ensuring decisions reflect vehicle-level impacts.
Define and monitor measurable technical and integration readiness criteria.

Full-Vehicle BOM and Cost Management

Maintain program-level visibility and governance of the full-vehicle BOM across systems, modules, and commodities.
Drive achievement of BOM cost targets with Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Cost Engineering, and external partners.
Evaluate cost, content, timing, quality, investment, and performance trade-offs and ensure approved changes are reflected in the program baseline.
Identify BOM and cost risks early and coordinate mitigation, recovery, and escalation.

Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management

Establish and maintain integrated risk, issue, action, and dependency management for the vehicle program.
Proactively identify technical, software, schedule, resource, supplier, cost, quality, and launch risks.
Drive accountable mitigation and recovery plans with clear owners, timing, and impact assessments.
Escalate decisions and constraints with concise recommendations and transparent program impacts.

Cross-Functional and Software Coordination

Coordinate execution across Vehicle Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software, Electronics, Powertrain, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Validation, Finance, Service, and Operations.
Align software release plans, feature maturity, validation, and integration events with hardware builds and vehicle milestones.
Ensure cross-functional stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, interfaces, commitments, and decision timing.

External Partner Management

Support as a vehicle-program interface for key suppliers, technology partners, and development partners.
Lead recurring schedule and timing reviews, deliverable tracking, and recovery planning with external stakeholders.
Coordinate technical issue-resolution discussions across internal teams and partners, driving closure of integration, quality, validation, and launch concerns.

The position requires knowledge of project management methodologies, manufacturing NPI processes, and supply/demand requirements. new_jobs.description:
Overview

Founded in 1973, Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is a leading global security company, providing a full range of physical security services to government and commercial customers on four continents. Inter-Con specializes in providing customized security services to clients whose needs exceed the capabilities of traditional guard firms. Clients include the Departments of State, Justice, Homeland Security, Energy, and Defense, as well as Fortune 500 companies, major public utilities, and ultra-high net worth individuals.

Inter-Con employs over 35,000 security personnel world-wide, trained and managed by a team of professionals with unsurpassed military, law enforcement, and security experience. Inter-Con remains 100% family owned and managed and operates as the industry leader in the field of customized, high-requirement security solutions.

Inter-Con is Everywhere Security Matters.

Job Summary

Inter-Con Security Systems is seeking a Project Manager to oversee daily security operations for a large, geographically dispersed public social services contract. The contract includes 19 locations, approximately 3,000 weekly security service hours, and approximately 70 security officers across northern Los Angeles County and surrounding communities.

The Project Manager serves as a client liaison and coordinates security services, supervises assigned personnel, and manages timekeeping, personnel administration, and payroll support. This hands-on leadership role requires regular site visits, strong follow-through, and the ability to balance field operations with accurate administrative support.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Oversee day-to-day security service delivery across assigned locations, ensuring operations meet contract requirements, client expectations, and Inter-Con procedures.
Serve as a liaison with the Client Security personnel; address service concerns and coordinate timely follow-up.
Supervise assigned supervisors and security officers, communicate expectations, coach performance, and coordinate personnel matters with appropriate Inter-Con teams.
Coordinate staffing, schedules, and coverage with supervisors to maintain required service levels and address attendance or coverage issues.
Review timekeeping records for accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and provide timely personnel and payroll support.
Conduct regular site visits, including weekly visits to outlying locations, to assess service quality, support employees, and maintain client relationships.
Coordinate responses to operational issues and incidents, ensure appropriate escalation, and maintain clear documentation and follow-through.
Prepare and maintain operational reports, staffing records, and other required administrative documentation.
Partner with the Contract Manager on reporting, contract compliance, and resource needs; apply financial awareness to staffing and overtime decisions.
Support contract transition activities, personnel readiness, and implementation of site procedures.
Perform other duties related to security operations and contract service delivery as assigned.

Required Qualifications

At least three years of experience within the last five years providing security management services on a contract of similar size and scope.
High school diploma or equivalent.
Experience supervising security personnel and coordinating operations across multiple locations.
Strong client service, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to maintain accurate timekeeping, personnel records, payroll support documentation, and operational reports.
Financial acumen, including an understanding of how staffing, scheduling, and overtime affect contract operations.
Proficiency with standard business software and the ability to learn scheduling, timekeeping, and reporting systems.
Ability to travel regularly throughout the service area and conduct weekly visits to outlying sites.
Ability to successfully complete required background screening.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing security services in public-facing government or social services environments.
Experience supporting a contract transition or new service launch.
Bilingual communication skills.

Work Environment and Travel

The position combines office administration with field oversight at client locations. Commerce is the preferred base, with recruiting also focused on the Sylmar area. The service footprint includes Pomona, El Monte, Monterey Park, Burbank, Chatsworth, Palmdale, Lancaster, and surrounding communities. Regular travel between these sites is an essential part of the role.

Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Disability/Veteran.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Oversee day-to-day security operations, including internal and external access control, CCTV monitoring, lost and found, and incident response and investigation.
Serve as the property's lead for Fire Life Safety (FLS), ensuring full compliance with NYC Fire Department (FDNY) codes and regulations, including required certifications, permits, and inspections.
Maintain and administer the property's Fire Safety and Emergency Action Plan (FSEAP), coordinating regular fire drills, evacuation procedures, and staff training in accordance with NYC Local Law and FDNY requirements.
Ensure Fire Safety Director, Fire Safety Coordinators, and other required certified personnel are properly designated, trained, and current on FDNY certificate requirements (e.g., F-80, F-58, or successor certifications as applicable).
Manage relationships with third-party contractors and vendors, including fire alarm monitoring companies, sprinkler and suppression system inspectors, elevator/fire pump technicians, and security systems vendors — overseeing scheduling, scope of work, invoicing, and contract compliance.
Coordinate and track all required inspections and testing (fire alarm, sprinkler, standpipe, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, generator/fire pump) to ensure timely completion and accurate recordkeeping for NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) and FDNY compliance.
Develop and maintain emergency response and crisis management plans covering fire, medical emergencies, severe weather, workplace violence, and other property-specific risks.
Partner with local authorities and emergency services (FDNY, NYPD, EMS) to maintain effective communication and rapid response capabilities.
Oversee the selection, placement, and performance of security technologies, including CCTV, access control, and fire/life safety alarm systems.
Work with all departments to ensure safety practices are followed, including chemical storage and use, slip/trip/fall hazard mitigation, machine guarding, safe manual material handling (ergonomics, lifting technique, task design), contractor safety management, and injury/illness prevention.
Maintain accurate logs, incident reports, and compliance documentation to support audits by FDNY, DOB, OSHA, and insurance carriers.
Serve as an active member of the property's safety/risk committee, partnering with cross-functional leaders to: Support implementation of the health, safety, and security management system
Drive engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement in safety culture
Review incidents, trends, and risk mitigation strategies at the property level

Collaborate with People & Culture and property leadership on on-property investigations.
Maintain a strong partnership with Rooms and Guest Experience teams to ensure security and safety protocols support a seamless guest experience.
Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion at all times.

WHAT YOU BRING

Degree or diploma in a relevant discipline, or equivalent experience.
Minimum of 4–6 years of progressive experience in hotel, commercial, or residential building security/safety management, with direct responsibility for Fire Life Safety compliance.
Working knowledge of NYC Fire Code, FDNY regulations, and Local Law requirements (e.g., Local Law 26, fire alarm and sprinkler testing rules) and NYC Department of Buildings compliance obligations.
Hands-on experience managing third-party contractors and vendors, including scope negotiation, scheduling, and quality control.
Current or ability to obtain required FDNY certifications (e.g., Fire Safety Director, Fire Guard, or equivalent as required for the property's occupancy classification).

About the Company

Project Manager – Program Security Architect

Location- Boston, MA 02108

Mode of Work- Hybrid

Mode of Hire- Contract

Job ID- ITS87 RFR-FY27-004- BEST Program Security Architect

Hybrid Work Model

The BEST program operates under the Office of the Comptroller (CTR) hybrid work model. Under this policy, employees are currently required to work a minimum of four (4) business days per month (two (2) set by management and two (2) set by the employee) on-site at CTR’s Boston office and may work remotely the remainder of the time at a location approved by their supervisor, so long as they comply with the requirements of the telework policy. Under this policy, all employees must be able to report to the Boston office with little or no notice, even including the same workday should an exigent circumstance arise. Therefore, a reasonable proximity to the office is necessary. CTR does not reimburse for employees to travel to the office.

About the Role

Position Summary

The BEST Program Security Architect will work for the BEST Solution Technical Lead and Deputy Program Manager to support the adoption of the future state end user security solution and protocols. Together with the BEST PMO and BEST Phase 2 Technical Lead, Comptroller Risk Management Team, Product Vendor, Systems Integrator (SI), Office of the Comptroller, and Executive Office of Technology Services and Security (EOTSS) staff to deploy technical controls to meet specific end-user security requirements, enable processes and standards to ensure that security configurations are maintained in the new Human Resource Management and Payroll solution.

As a key member of the project’s Security Team, the Risk and Compliance Lead will work closely with other team members to develop and implement a comprehensive information security program.

Responsibilities

This includes:

Design and recommend protocols and procedures for monitoring the product vendor’s performance against Service Level Agreement standards regarding data security, annual security audits, and disaster recovery testing.

Propose security policies, processes and standards related to end- user roles, data access for application users, and how users will be provisioned and de-provisioned.
Provide input on selection, deployment, and oversight of security technologies and other compliance and risk management/mitigation strategies.

Monitoring and assessing business continuity and disaster recovery programs, network penetration, and other tests to assess application vulnerability; and

The Software as a Solution (SaaS) model chosen by the Commonwealth includes data security protocols and procedures that are audited annually by a third party. The Service Level Agreement (SLA) and contract documentation between the Commonwealth and the system integration and product vendor outline the terms and conditions for maintaining data security, which will be monitored by the Commonwealth. The BEST Risk and Compliance Lead will assist the Commonwealth in implementing necessary procedures to meet risk mitigation requirements and monitor vendor compliance with security protocols.

This role involves collaborating with program functional teams to identify end-user roles and permissions for implementing the new Human Resource and Payroll solution across all agencies and user types, ensuring appropriate data access. User security procedures will be developed in conjunction with the BEST Phase 2 Technical Lead, Comptroller Risk Management Team, the system integration and product vendor, and agency staff responsible for user provisioning and deprovisioning.

In addition this position will coordinate with the BEST program's Independent Verification and Validation (IV &V) vendor necessary to ensure proper adoption.

This role is responsible for translating complex security problems into sound technical solutions, providing technical security and architectural direction to technology business teams, ensuring that development efforts are adhering to security design and compliance standards and requirements, providing insights and guidance on overall secure system design, and documenting and communicating security architectural requirements.

Specific Duties

This position will oversee implementation of the three major security components:

Application Security
User Authentication security

Partner with EOTSS to onboard Workday and Workday Prism to work with the Commonwealth Single Sign On - SSO for employees and for vendors, as appropriate. Work with EOTSS on and oversee security and compliance testing / documentation and review/remediate results/issues, as necessary on collaboration with the Comptroller Risk Management team.
Work with the BEST technical leadership to develop strategies, procedures and recommended roles and responsibilities to enforce security requirements and address identified risks related to the use of the new solution and suitability of underlying internal controls and technologies.
Provide recommendations regarding end user security roles and groups, data access controls and security role provisioning (onboarding) and de-provisioning (offboarding) protocols to ensure that data are accessed appropriately in the new solution in cooperation with the Comptroller Risk Management Team.
Participate in disaster recovery, business continuity, back up, operational planning, as well as support disaster recovery/business continuity testing, and documentation.
Oversee establishment of the overall Security Incident Event Management (SIEM) across several security operational domains including Cloud SaaS vendor, Comptroller’s office,

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Professional Services
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

Austin, US
San Francisco, CA
New York, NY

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and seasoned Senior Project Manager to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will lead the governance and end-to-end execution of complex, high-stakes migration and implementation projects for our most strategic customers. Serving as the primary bridge between sales, technical delivery teams, and executive stakeholders, you will ensure that sophisticated cybersecurity and networking solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with agreed success criteria for minimal-disruption or zero-/low-downtime outcomes.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience in professional services, SaaS or cloud technology delivery, project management, and executive-level customer relationship management. We believe that putting our people first and fostering a creative, exciting, and stimulating environment is a prerequisite to achieving our commercial goals.

Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional teams of technical professionals, consultants, FDE’s, partners, vendors, and customer stakeholders to deliver complex consulting and multi-workstream implementation services in mission-critical enterprise environments.
Own project governance across the full project lifecycle, including project charters, scope definition, success criteria, delivery plans, RAID management, stakeholder communications, change control, acceptance criteria, and closeout / lessons learned.
Establish and maintain high-trust relationships with key customers, partners, and vendors to drive long-term satisfaction, adoption, and revenue growth.
Ensure Professional Services engagements are delivered on time and within budget by actively managing project financials, resource forecasts, scope performance, timeline performance, change requests, and executive reporting.
Develop, implement, and refine scalable methodologies, playbooks, templates, and best practices that improve the global efficiency and effectiveness of Professional Services delivery.
Ensure a seamless and consultative sales-to-delivery transition by validating scope, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and customer success criteria before project kickoff.
Proactively identify project risks, including zero- or low-downtime migrations, multi-vendor dependencies, resource constraints, scope changes, and customer operational impact, and implement mitigation strategies to protect customer outcomes.
Transform raw project data into clear, data-driven insights and regular status narratives for internal and external leadership regarding project health, risks, decisions, financials, and resource utilization.
Proactively leverage AI tools to optimize project workflows and technical delivery, serving as a force multiplier for project teams by streamlining administrative work, improving visibility, and increasing overall project productivity.
Collaborate across Account Teams, Customer Engineers, Support, Product, Engineering, Professional Services leadership, and other internal stakeholders to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Project and Portfolio Management: Mastery of project and portfolio management (PPM) principles, with the ability to oversee a high volume of concurrent workstreams while maintaining strategic alignment with customer and business objectives.
Strategic Execution: Proven ability to manage ambiguity, shifting priorities, and competing stakeholder needs while maintaining disciplined prioritization, scoping, and delivery governance.
Executive Presence: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the credibility and gravitas to influence C-suite stakeholders, lead through persuasion, and communicate complex delivery topics clearly.
Ambiguity and Operational Craftsmanship: Proven ability to remain effective and organized in an evolving environment where processes are still being defined. We are looking for a builder who can identify gaps in the current delivery lifecycle and proactively establish the governance frameworks, playbooks, and internal standards necessary to scale the organization.
Technical Literacy: Working knowledge of how the Internet works, including networking, security, Zero Trust / SASE, DNS, APIs, and related technologies. This person should be able to partner effectively with technical delivery teams without needing to be the technical owner.
AI-Enabled Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tooling responsibly to improve project planning, summarization, risk identification, reporting, and team productivity.
Change Management: Experience in organizational change management, including guiding enterprise customers through the cultural and operational shifts required by digital transformation and technology migration programs.
Conflict Resolution: Advanced skills in managing friction within project teams, across internal stakeholders, or with customers to reach mutually beneficial outcomes.
Collaborative Leadership: Proven ability to navigate and influence a complex matrix of internal stakeholders, including Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services leadership, to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.

Experience

Minimum of 8+ years of experience in professional services, project management, program management, or a senior customer-facing delivery role within a high-growth technology environment.
Highly organized, with exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, dependencies, and executive stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated track record of leading high-profile, high-impact projects involving third-party partners, consultants, technical delivery teams, and complex multi-vendor ecosystems.
Experience managing strategic customer programs from kickoff through closeout, including project charters, governance cadences, risk management, change control, executive reporting, and lessons learned.
Sound business judgment, an ownership mindset, strong analytical capability, and a proven ability to influence results across global stakeholders.
Expert proficiency with Jira, Salesforce, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or equivalent project / portfolio management tools.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or related advanced project / program management certification is highly preferred.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $155,000 - $213,000.
For NY and Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $149,000 - $205,000.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1

This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
