Functiebeschrijving

Wil jij IT-projecten leiden die raken aan de kern van moderne retailorganisaties? Als IT Project Manager Retail & Consumer Products werk je aan platformvernieuwing, integraties, data, cloud, omnichannel en digitale operatie. Je brengt business, IT en leveranciers bij elkaar en zorgt dat complexe projecten gecontroleerd en succesvol worden gerealiseerd.

Jouw rol in ons team

Als IT Project Manager Retail & Consumer Products leid je projecten die raken aan de kern van moderne retailorganisaties: platformvernieuwing, integraties, data, cloud, omnichannel en digitale operatie. Je brengt structuur, houdt regie op scope, planning, budget en risico’s en zorgt dat business, IT en leveranciers dezelfde kant op bewegen. Je bent geen puur administratieve projectmanager, maar iemand die voldoende technische bagage heeft om de inhoud te begrijpen en klantteams vertrouwen te geven.

Hoe jij ons team versterkt

Leiden van IT-projecten binnen retail-, consumer-services- of vergelijkbare enterprise omgevingen.
Sturen op planning, scope, budget, risico’s, dependencies, besluitvorming en voortgangsrapportage.
Verbinden van business stakeholders, product owners, architecten, engineers en externe leveranciers.
Begeleiden van platformimplementaties, integraties, migraties, data-/cloudprojecten of moderniseringstrajecten.
Signaleren van risico’s, verbeterkansen en mogelijke vervolgopdrachten bij klanten.
Bijdragen aan projectaanpakken, offertes, klantpresentaties en herbruikbare delivery-templates.

Dit ben jij:

5-7 jaar ervaring in IT projectmanagement, delivery management of programmaondersteuning met aantoonbare eindverantwoordelijkheid.
Minimaal PRINCE2 Foundation; PRINCE2 Practitioner, IPMA of PMP is een sterke plus.
Aantoonbare ervaring met IT-platformen, integraties, data, cloud of applicatielandschappen.
Ervaring in retail, e-commerce, supply chain, logistiek, consumer services of een vergelijkbare enterprise omgeving.
Sterke stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en professionele beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.
Consultancy mindset: klantgericht, ondernemend, gestructureerd en comfortabel in commerciële gesprekken.

Daarnaast zien we graag:

Agile/Scrum certificering zoals PSM I, CSM of SAFe Agilist.
ITIL Foundation, Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), AWS Cloud Practitioner of vergelijkbare basiskennis.
Ervaring met Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project en projectrapportages voor stuurgroepen.
Kennis van retailprocessen zoals e-commerce, omnichannel, store operations, loyalty, CRM/ERP of supply chain.
Ervaring met leveranciersmanagement, contractafspraken, change management en escalaties.

Waar kom je terecht

Binnen Retail & Consumer Products van CGI helpen we organisaties om mee te bewegen met veranderend consumentengedrag en een steeds digitalere markt. We combineren domeinkennis met technologie op het gebied van onder meer data, AI, digitale klantbeleving en omnichannel om processen en klantinteracties te verbeteren. Je werkt samen met collega's en klanten aan oplossingen die de verbinding tussen klant, organisatie en operatie versterken.

Je komt terecht in een compact, ondernemend CGI-team dat zich richt op retail en consumer services. We werken dicht op klanten, bouwen aan herbruikbare offerings en combineren domeinkennis met CGI’s bredere expertise in business consulting, systems integration, data analytics, AI, cloud en managed services.

AI & Futureproof

Binnen CGI kijken we continu naar de impact van nieuwe technologieën op onze dienstverlening en de oplossingen die we voor onze klanten ontwikkelen. Ook ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en automatisering spelen hierin een steeds grotere rol.

Binnen Retail & Consumer Products spelen deze ontwikkelingen een belangrijke rol in de verdere modernisering van retailplatformen en digitale dienstverlening. Data, AI, cloud en automatisering bieden nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen onder andere omnichannel, e-commerce, store operations en supply chain. Als IT Project Manager zorg je ervoor dat dergelijke technologische ontwikkelingen beheerst kunnen worden meegenomen in projecten, waarbij je aandacht houdt voor integraties, afhankelijkheden, risico’s en de impact op de organisatie.

Waarom CGI

CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancybedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie-, transport- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Description

Job Summary

The Program Manager ensures manufacturing projects, programs, and activities are managed effectively and align with the broader objectives of the business. Collects, analyzes, and monitors manufacturing and production data to identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies and implement improvements to processes, workflows, or methods. Facilitates communication and collaboration between various functions including design, procurement, and quality assurance to ensure actions and goals are aligned.

Coordinates vendors and suppliers to support program activities and ensures cost, quality, and availability meet customer specifications and schedules. Acts as the primary customer contact for quotations, cost and contract questions, and program issues or changes in requirements. May provide technical support at customer facilities. Requires a bachelor's degree. Typically reports to a manager.

Work is occasionally directed, but generally independent and collaborative in nature. Contributes to moderately complex aspects of a project. May provide training, guidance, and delegate tasks to other team members. Typically requires 2-4 years of directly related experience.

Essential Functions

Lead planning and implementation of onboarding clients.
Develop and maintain detailed integration plans and schedules.
Lead requirements, design, development and testing of integration phases.
Follow a defined, agreed upon project management methodology.
Facilitate the definition of project goals, tasks, and resource requirements.
Convey goals and objectives clearly to project team.
Identify, track and resolve project risks and issues.
Resolve or assist in the resolution of conflicts within and between projects or functional areas.
Ensure integration status, issues and successes are communicated to project team, management and documented appropriately.
Develop methods to monitor integration progress and provide corrective supervision if necessary.
Lead project status calls or meetings.
Manage project resource allocation.
Manage tasks and people.
Interact regularly with clients to determine their needs and to develop plans for improving delivery.
Work cross-functionally to solve problems and implement changes.
Motivate project team members to action.
Ensure open communication on the project team.
Relate well to others, to dictate responsibilities, to offer constructive feedback, and to support and encourage others.
Address delicate situations and handle conflicts in such a way as to maximize opportunity and minimize exposure to risk.
Address problems with problem-solving skills and ability to think quickly and adeptly.
Prioritize own and team’s work.
Forecast changes and communicate current and projected issues.
Add and update Program Management tool.
Engage, coordinate and plan 3rd party vendor activities and resources.
Complies with all policies and procedures pertaining to the protection of the Company’s Information Assets, Security and Systems and that of its Clients.

PM22

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
Minimum 5 years working in manufacturing preferred
Outstanding communications skills, able to communicate with all levels of an organization.
Strong process orientation, problem solving and troubleshooting skills, and a firm commitment to quality.
Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
Proven balance of strategic and tactical skills.
Proven ability to consistently turn strategy and vision into reality through effective project management, technical solutions definition, and communications.
Proven aptitude for seeking creative solutions to multi-faceted problems.
Ability to establish and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Excellent problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Flexible with the ability to work in a collaborative style and move others to action by planning, motivating and organizing work tasks.
Excellent interpersonal skills that establish and maintain credibility and relationships.
Able to work effectively with internal and external customers and suppliers
Professional mature demeanor under stressful conditions

Training program

Office

Potential for minor travel

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

Austin, TX
San Francisco, CA

About The Team

The Business Operations team sits within the CFO organization and is responsible for core company KPI reporting, incubating new analytics capabilities, and leading or facilitating cross-functional initiatives to design and operationalize high-impact programs. We are looking for an individual with strong analytical horsepower to join the team to provide decision-making support to Cloudflare’s strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate is passionate about problem solving and insight discovery, as well as is excited about rolling the sleeves to prototype MVPs and building high quality processes and tooling that scale with our rapid growth.

What You'll Do

Work on complex problems: identify root causes of the challenge and/or underlying business drivers, execute in-depth analyses to translate data into meaningful insights and/or repeatable gadgets or processes
Lead projects through the full cycle: from initial scoping, solution design, code execution, QA and to operationalization and enablement
Leverage latest AI technologies incl. Cloudflare OS, Developer Platform, emerging best practices to illustrate what can be possible in how we work
Synthesize audience relevant findings from the data to achieve alignments and support strategic decision making
Assess financial impact of new initiatives, identify approaches to risk mitigation, create forecast model on new metrics as needed
Work closely with Data Engineer and Data Science Team to track core KPIs, create visibility on new initiatives and its impact, and to streamline reporting processes as the projects mature
Provide ad-hoc analytical support to Finance & Executive Leadership

Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience

5+ years of Business Operations, Consulting, Investment Banking or Strategic Finance experience
Bachelor's degree, Data Science master or MBA a plus
Strategic thinker with strong business acumen: ability to zoom in with good attention to detail while still keeping the big picture in mind; excel at translating data into actionable insights or programs
Clear, concise and proactive communicator: ability to synthesize complex data or business problems into actionable information to drive results
Have a strong modeling foundation: high proficiency in building thoughtful, complex and auditable business model and present the outcome in an easy-to-understand format
Versatility: Results-oriented, self-starter, thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment; high proficiency in SQL or AI assisted coding required
Advanced/ working proficiency with English mandatory both written and verbal

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $130,000 - $179,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Medical/Rx Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Commuter Spending Accounts
Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
Life & Accident Insurance
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

new_jobs.description:
Position: EDI Integrations Lead/Manager

Overview:

We are seeking an EDI Integrations Lead
to own our electronic data interchange function end to end. You will own the trading partner integration portfolio, the operational service behind it, the platform vendor relationship, and the technical standard the function runs to. You will be the last stop for any EDI escalation, and you will direct one analyst.

This is a full-time, work-from-home, night-shift role.

Responsibilities:

Integration delivery

Own the trading partner integration portfolio: scope, sequence, dependencies, and committed delivery dates across concurrent onboardings
Own onboarding cycle time and on-time delivery as measured outcomes, not as reported status
Set the integration roadmap against Supply Chain, Finance, Pricing, and Commercial Operations priorities each quarter

EDI standards and solution design

Act as the final technical authority on EDI standards, transaction sets, and mapping design for the enterprise
Design integration architecture across the EDI platform, ERP, and downstream systems, including reusable transaction map patterns
Resolve standards conflicts, transaction rejections, and mapping defects at the segment level
Identify and scope automation across inbound and outbound transaction flows

Planning and delivery discipline

Produce a written plan in Azure DevOps before build starts on every initiative, with work breakdown, dependencies, estimates, risks, and launch criteria
Own the planning, tracking, and agile ceremony standard for the function. Sprint plans complete before sprint start, burndown reviewed weekly.
Maintain a rolling quarterly backlog with sprint-level detail two to four weeks ahead, including predictable non-project work
Surface schedule risk in the week you see it, with cause, impact, options, and a recommendation. Escalate before the date moves, not after.

Service reliability and operations

Own EDI platform health, transaction reliability, and incident response across all production integrations
Define, publish, and report the operational KPI set: onboarding cycle time, transaction error rate, acknowledgment performance, uptime, and incident resolution
Drive root cause elimination on recurring incidents. Own service improvement plans against measured baselines.
Maintain compliance-relevant data flows, including DSCSA serialization and EPCIS reporting obligations

Risk and dependency management

Identify cross-team, vendor, and partner dependencies during planning and build mitigation into plans and launch criteria
Maintain a forward risk view across the partner portfolio and platform, naming exposures before they affect committed dates
Escalate blocking dependencies with a recommended path forward

Partner and vendor management

Own the EDI platform vendor relationship: contract posture, service level structure, support model, and governance cadence
Manage trading partner relationships through onboarding, testing, go-live, and steady-state operation
Represent the company
in partner escalations up to and including partner leadership

Technical leadership and coaching

Direct and develop one EDI analyst, including career ladder placement, skill gap assessment, and a written development plan reviewed quarterly
Maintain documentation and cross-training sufficient to remove single-resource knowledge risk from the function
Set the technical standard for the function and review the technical work of others
Deliver executive-level reporting and analysis on EDI performance to IT and business leadership

Qualifications:

+10 years of hands-on EDI experience across development, integration, and operations
Expert command of X12 transaction sets and standards, including purchase order, invoice, advance ship notice, chargeback, acknowledgment, and inventory or sales reporting transactions
You have owned a production EDI environment, including incident response and platform health, not just built to spec
You have delivered trading partner onboardings end to end, from requirements through go-live
You have owned a technology vendor relationship, including service level and escalation governance
You have delivered against committed dates across a portfolio of concurrent initiatives, not one project at a time
Deep working knowledge of Azure DevOps or an equivalent work management platform, including backlog structure, work breakdown, and reporting
You have integrated EDI with an ERP platform. NetSuite is a plus.
You have delivered in a regulated environment with external audit or compliance obligations (FDA, DEA, DSCSA, SOC 2, SOX, or GxP)
Working knowledge of AS2, SFTP, and VAN connectivity models
You can carry technical detail and business impact to an executive audience in the same conversation
Strong written and verbal English, working directly with US-based stakeholders

Why Join Us?

Join a company solving real-world challenges in healthcare and logistics.
Own a function end to end rather than a queue of assigned tickets.
Set the technical standard for how EDI works across the enterprise.
Grow your career on a technical track that advances on depth and scope rather than headcount.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Freight Digital Customer Journey
new_jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
Global Customer Service, Ferry Division (DFDS)

Join us on our journey to transform the freight customer experience at DFDS.

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a strong track record of leading complex, technology-enabled transformation initiatives from the business side? Do you excel at translating operational needs into clear business requirements, future processes, and scalable digital capabilities, while aligning stakeholders across business and technology? If so, you may be the next Senior Project Manager in DFDS Global Customer Service, Ferry Commercial.

Be part of the movement - and play your part

About The Role

In this role, you will drive key initiatives within the transformation of the digital customer journey to support our Freight Customer Service organisation at DFDS. Our ambition is clear: by 2030, we want to deliver a seamless, digital, and standardised set-up that makes it easy to be a customer and easy to interact with customers across all freight touchpoints.

To achieve this, our Customer Service transformation is built on three strategic pillars:

1. Self-Service: The first pillar is about building a one-stop-shop, with customers being able to book and track a unit along the whole journey and across transport modalities.
2. Contact Center Platform: An interaction platform to easily engage with customers, when they need our support - including a knowledge base to further enhance the customer experience.
3. Control Tower: The Control Tower is our internal platform for managing customer bookings. It will give Customer Service a more seamless and standardised way to manage bookings and track units across the DFDS network

In this role, your primary responsibility will be to lead the business-side development of the Control Tower and its booking capabilities, while also supporting key initiatives within the broader transformation of the digital customer journey across Freight Customer Service.

The Control Tower is our internal platform designed to help Customer Service work smarter through aligned processes, greater transparency, and improved access to the information needed to manage customer bookings across the DFDS network.

As the representative of Global Customer Service, you will partner closely with Technology & Innovation (T&I) to support the development of the Control Tower and its booking capabilities, ensuring operational needs and business requirements are translated into scalable product capabilities. You will drive discovery, process mapping, standardisation, and business requirement prioritisation, while creating alignment across stakeholders and managing cross-functional dependencies.

You will play a key role in driving change adoption, helping the organisation transition from legacy ways of working to our new digital platform and ways of operating.

You will join a small, dedicated project and transformation team that works toward digitizing our customer journey which is a key part of our DFDS strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Act as the overall business lead from Global Customer Service for the Control Tower and its booking capabilities.
Lead the business workstream from discovery and design through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement in close collaboration with your project team.
Partner and co-create closely with Technology & Innovation, translating operational needs and business requirements into scalable product capabilities.
Lead stakeholder alignment across Customer Service, Commercial, Operations, and Technology & Innovation, ensuring clear priorities and effective collaboration.
Drive process standardisation and support future-state design across the freight booking journey.
Establish and manage project governance, plans, risks, dependencies, and decision-making processes.
Facilitate workshops and decision forums, preparing recommendations and updates for senior leadership and governance bodies in close collaboration with project and product owner team.
Drive change management, business readiness, impact assessment, implementation, and adoption to ensure successful deployment and value realisation.
Define success measures and ensure delivered capabilities support more efficient, aligned, and transparent ways of working across Customer Service.

About You

We believe the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we imagine that you bring: 

Experience as a Project Manager, Business Transformation Lead, or similar, with a strong track record of leading complex cross-functional technology-enabled transformation and driving organisational change.
Strong skills in bridging business and technology, translating operational needs into business requirements.
Ideally, experience from logistics, shipping, transportation, B2B customer service, supply chain, or another operationally complex industry.
Strong project and change management skills with ability to create structure, alignment, and momentum in environments characterised by ambiguity, competing priorities, and multiple dependencies.
Ideally, experience with business discovery, process mapping, process optimisation, future-state design, and change adoption. Experience with Lean Six Sigma or a similar continuous improvement methodology is an advantage.
Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills and ability to build alignment and drive decisions across functions, organisational levels, and geographical locations while still ensuring engagement.
Ability to facilitate workshops and present recommendations and decision material to senior stakeholders.
A combination of strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, enjoying to work closely with operational teams with curiosity to understand business ways of working and translating these into innovation .
Ability to use PowerPoint, Excel, and process mapping tools. Experience with Power BI, business analysis tools, or automation tools is advantageous.
A bachelor's or master's degree in business, economics, shipping, technology, engineering, or a related field is advantageous.

You will report to the Ferry Customer Service Transformation Manager.

The role is based at the DFDS Headquarters in Copenhagen. Some travel may be expected (approx. 5-10 days a year).

Working at DFDS

At DFDS, we support your professional and personal development. You will have the opportunity to challenge yourself, grow your skills, and help shape the future of customer service and digital transformation in the ferry industry.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community and a healthy work/life balance. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Apply now - Are we a match?

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and desire match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis and we hope to close this process already in October - and we therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Professional Services
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

Austin, US
San Francisco, CA
New York, NY

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and seasoned Senior Project Manager to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will lead the governance and end-to-end execution of complex, high-stakes migration and implementation projects for our most strategic customers. Serving as the primary bridge between sales, technical delivery teams, and executive stakeholders, you will ensure that sophisticated cybersecurity and networking solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with agreed success criteria for minimal-disruption or zero-/low-downtime outcomes.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience in professional services, SaaS or cloud technology delivery, project management, and executive-level customer relationship management. We believe that putting our people first and fostering a creative, exciting, and stimulating environment is a prerequisite to achieving our commercial goals.

Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional teams of technical professionals, consultants, FDE’s, partners, vendors, and customer stakeholders to deliver complex consulting and multi-workstream implementation services in mission-critical enterprise environments.
Own project governance across the full project lifecycle, including project charters, scope definition, success criteria, delivery plans, RAID management, stakeholder communications, change control, acceptance criteria, and closeout / lessons learned.
Establish and maintain high-trust relationships with key customers, partners, and vendors to drive long-term satisfaction, adoption, and revenue growth.
Ensure Professional Services engagements are delivered on time and within budget by actively managing project financials, resource forecasts, scope performance, timeline performance, change requests, and executive reporting.
Develop, implement, and refine scalable methodologies, playbooks, templates, and best practices that improve the global efficiency and effectiveness of Professional Services delivery.
Ensure a seamless and consultative sales-to-delivery transition by validating scope, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and customer success criteria before project kickoff.
Proactively identify project risks, including zero- or low-downtime migrations, multi-vendor dependencies, resource constraints, scope changes, and customer operational impact, and implement mitigation strategies to protect customer outcomes.
Transform raw project data into clear, data-driven insights and regular status narratives for internal and external leadership regarding project health, risks, decisions, financials, and resource utilization.
Proactively leverage AI tools to optimize project workflows and technical delivery, serving as a force multiplier for project teams by streamlining administrative work, improving visibility, and increasing overall project productivity.
Collaborate across Account Teams, Customer Engineers, Support, Product, Engineering, Professional Services leadership, and other internal stakeholders to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Project and Portfolio Management: Mastery of project and portfolio management (PPM) principles, with the ability to oversee a high volume of concurrent workstreams while maintaining strategic alignment with customer and business objectives.
Strategic Execution: Proven ability to manage ambiguity, shifting priorities, and competing stakeholder needs while maintaining disciplined prioritization, scoping, and delivery governance.
Executive Presence: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the credibility and gravitas to influence C-suite stakeholders, lead through persuasion, and communicate complex delivery topics clearly.
Ambiguity and Operational Craftsmanship: Proven ability to remain effective and organized in an evolving environment where processes are still being defined. We are looking for a builder who can identify gaps in the current delivery lifecycle and proactively establish the governance frameworks, playbooks, and internal standards necessary to scale the organization.
Technical Literacy: Working knowledge of how the Internet works, including networking, security, Zero Trust / SASE, DNS, APIs, and related technologies. This person should be able to partner effectively with technical delivery teams without needing to be the technical owner.
AI-Enabled Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tooling responsibly to improve project planning, summarization, risk identification, reporting, and team productivity.
Change Management: Experience in organizational change management, including guiding enterprise customers through the cultural and operational shifts required by digital transformation and technology migration programs.
Conflict Resolution: Advanced skills in managing friction within project teams, across internal stakeholders, or with customers to reach mutually beneficial outcomes.
Collaborative Leadership: Proven ability to navigate and influence a complex matrix of internal stakeholders, including Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services leadership, to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.

Experience

Minimum of 8+ years of experience in professional services, project management, program management, or a senior customer-facing delivery role within a high-growth technology environment.
Highly organized, with exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, dependencies, and executive stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated track record of leading high-profile, high-impact projects involving third-party partners, consultants, technical delivery teams, and complex multi-vendor ecosystems.
Experience managing strategic customer programs from kickoff through closeout, including project charters, governance cadences, risk management, change control, executive reporting, and lessons learned.
Sound business judgment, an ownership mindset, strong analytical capability, and a proven ability to influence results across global stakeholders.
Expert proficiency with Jira, Salesforce, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or equivalent project / portfolio management tools.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or related advanced project / program management certification is highly preferred.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $155,000 - $213,000.
For NY and Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $149,000 - $205,000.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Job Summary

The MHS Project Manager / Senior Manager will be responsible for overseeing the design, submissions, construction, testing and commissioning, and ORAT activities associated with the Material Handling System (MHS) for a major international airport project.

The role will provide senior-level leadership and coordination across the MHS contractor, project team, end users, stakeholders, and other relevant disciplines to ensure that the MHS is delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements, specifications, programme, quality standards, and operational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee the design, technical submissions, approvals, procurement, construction, installation, testing and commissioning activities associated with the MHS.
Manage and monitor the MHS contractor’s performance to ensure compliance with approved designs, contract requirements, project specifications, programme, quality standards, and HSE requirements.
Provide strategic and technical oversight of all MHS-related construction activities, ensuring effective coordination with other project disciplines and contractors.
Review and monitor MHS contractor deliverables, including design submissions, method statements, shop drawings, material submissions, inspection requests, testing procedures, commissioning documentation, and as-built information.
Coordinate and integrate the requirements of end users, airport operators, authorities, and other key stakeholders, ensuring their operational and technical needs are properly addressed.
Act as a key interface between the MHS contractor, project management team, consultants, airport stakeholders, end users, and other contractors.
Identify and resolve technical, construction, interface, programme, and operational issues affecting the MHS.
Oversee Testing & Commissioning (T&C) activities to ensure that the MHS meets the required performance, reliability, safety, and operational criteria.
Lead and coordinate ORAT (Operational Readiness, Activation and Transition) activities related to the MHS, ensuring operational readiness prior to airport opening and/or commencement of operations.
Monitor progress against the approved programme and proactively identify potential delays, risks, and critical interface issues.
Ensure appropriate coordination of MHS works with related airport systems, including baggage handling, building services, ICT, security, civil, architectural, MEP, and other operational systems as applicable.
Participate in inspections, factory acceptance tests, site acceptance tests, integrated systems testing, commissioning, and operational trials as required.
Ensure that construction and installation activities are carried out in accordance with approved HSE, quality, environmental, and airport safety requirements.
Review and contribute to risk assessments, mitigation measures, change management, and technical/commercial issues relating to MHS.
Organize, chair, and/or attend regularly scheduled project and coordination meetings with the MHS contractor, stakeholders, consultants, and project team.
Ensure effective follow-up and closeout of actions arising from meetings, inspections, testing, commissioning, and stakeholder reviews.
Support the project team through handover, completion, documentation, training, operational readiness, and final closeout of the MHS works.
Provide regular management reporting on MHS progress, risks, issues, interfaces, testing and commissioning, and readiness status.

Qualifications

Recognized Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline.
Minimum 15 years of professional experience working on large-scale and/or complex construction projects.
Minimum 10 years of middle/senior management experience on large international airport projects.
Proven experience managing MHS projects within major international airports, preferably involving complex passenger terminal developments.
Strong experience in managing specialist contractors, consultants, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary project interfaces.
Demonstrated experience in testing & commissioning and ORAT for airport systems.
Strong understanding of airport construction, operational interfaces, systems integration, and project delivery processes.
Excellent leadership, communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and resolve complex technical and interface issues in a high-pressure international project environment.

Additional Information

To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

Austin, US
San Francisco, CA
New York, NY

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and seasoned Senior Project Manager to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will lead the governance and end-to-end execution of complex, high-stakes migration and implementation projects for our most strategic customers. Serving as the primary bridge between sales, technical delivery teams, and executive stakeholders, you will ensure that sophisticated cybersecurity and networking solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with agreed success criteria for minimal-disruption or zero-/low-downtime outcomes.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience in professional services, SaaS or cloud technology delivery, project management, and executive-level customer relationship management. We believe that putting our people first and fostering a creative, exciting, and stimulating environment is a prerequisite to achieving our commercial goals.

Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional teams of technical professionals, consultants, FDE’s, partners, vendors, and customer stakeholders to deliver complex consulting and multi-workstream implementation services in mission-critical enterprise environments.
Own project governance across the full project lifecycle, including project charters, scope definition, success criteria, delivery plans, RAID management, stakeholder communications, change control, acceptance criteria, and closeout / lessons learned.
Establish and maintain high-trust relationships with key customers, partners, and vendors to drive long-term satisfaction, adoption, and revenue growth.
Ensure Professional Services engagements are delivered on time and within budget by actively managing project financials, resource forecasts, scope performance, timeline performance, change requests, and executive reporting.
Develop, implement, and refine scalable methodologies, playbooks, templates, and best practices that improve the global efficiency and effectiveness of Professional Services delivery.
Ensure a seamless and consultative sales-to-delivery transition by validating scope, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and customer success criteria before project kickoff.
Proactively identify project risks, including zero- or low-downtime migrations, multi-vendor dependencies, resource constraints, scope changes, and customer operational impact, and implement mitigation strategies to protect customer outcomes.

Proactively leverage AI tools to optimize project workflows and technical delivery, serving as a force multiplier for project teams by streamlining administrative work, improving visibility, and increasing overall project productivity.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Strategic Execution: Proven ability to manage ambiguity, shifting priorities, and competing stakeholder needs while maintaining disciplined prioritization, scoping, and delivery governance.
Executive Presence: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the credibility and gravitas to influence C-suite stakeholders, lead through persuasion, and communicate complex delivery topics clearly.
Ambiguity and Operational Craftsmanship: Proven ability to remain effective and organized in an evolving environment where processes are still being defined. We are looking for a builder who can identify gaps in the current delivery lifecycle and proactively establish the governance frameworks, playbooks, and internal standards necessary to scale the organization.
Technical Literacy: Working knowledge of how the Internet works, including networking, security, Zero Trust / SASE, DNS, APIs, and related technologies. This person should be able to partner effectively with technical delivery teams without needing to be the technical owner.
AI-Enabled Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tooling responsibly to improve project planning, summarization, risk identification, reporting, and team productivity.
Change Management: Experience in organizational change management, including guiding enterprise customers through the cultural and operational shifts required by digital transformation and technology migration programs.
Conflict Resolution: Advanced skills in managing friction within project teams, across internal stakeholders, or with customers to reach mutually beneficial outcomes.
Collaborative Leadership: Proven ability to navigate and influence a complex matrix of internal stakeholders, including Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services leadership, to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.

Experience

Minimum of 8+ years of experience in professional services, project management, program management, or a senior customer-facing delivery role within a high-growth technology environment.
Highly organized, with exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, dependencies, and executive stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated track record of leading high-profile, high-impact projects involving third-party partners, consultants, technical delivery teams, and complex multi-vendor ecosystems.
Experience managing strategic customer programs from kickoff through closeout, including project charters, governance cadences, risk management, change control, executive reporting, and lessons learned.
Sound business judgment, an ownership mindset, strong analytical capability, and a proven ability to influence results across global stakeholders.
Expert proficiency with Jira, Salesforce, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or equivalent project / portfolio management tools.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or related advanced project / program management certification is highly preferred.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $155,000 - $213,000.
For NY and Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $149,000 - $205,000.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

new_jobs.title: Data Intelligence Manager
new_jobs.description:
Who We’re Looking For

Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data & Operations team based in Pune, India. You will be the operational owner of reporting and analytics for a core business function (G&A, R&D, or GTM), turning raw data into accurate, timely, and trusted intelligence that drive decisions at the executive and departmental level. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.

What You’ll Be Doing

The primary responsibilities for this role include:

Own the end-to-end delivery of non-native dashboards for your assigned business function (G&A, R&D, or GTM), combining data across multiple source systems into a single, accurate view
Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented
Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions
Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision-ready intelligence
Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting
Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs
Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live
Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early
Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated
Contribute to cross-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure
Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape

At Fieldwire, we’re looking for our next Data Intelligence Manager to have the following skills and experiences:

3-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role
Strong proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience building dashboards in Power BI
Experience working with large datasets across multiple systems and understanding how to combine them into coherent reporting
Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous QA on data outputs and maintain high standards of accuracy
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills — able to identify inconsistencies and root-cause data issues independently
Experience defining and governing KPIs and metrics frameworks
Excellent communication skills — able to present complex data findings clearly to non-technical business stakeholders
Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts and how data pipelines work upstream of analytics
Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
Comfortable working across time zones in a globally distributed team

And if you have any of the following, we
REALLY
want you to apply today!

Experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to GTM, Finance, or R&D data
Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and data structures
Experience working with dbt, Snowflake, or similar modern data stack components
Exposure to data governance frameworks and metric catalogues
Prior experience supporting executive-level reporting or board-level dashboards
Background in construction technology or field operations analytics is a plus

Why Fieldwire?

The field-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. BRP’s Global Security Team is seeking a motivated Intelligence Analyst to support global intelligence, threat monitoring, and situational awareness activities that protect BRP’s people, property, products, and brand reputation.

Based in Mexico (Juárez Campus), the Intelligence Analyst will support the Intelligence Lead and Global Security team in collecting, analyzing, and disseminating information related to security risks affecting BRP’s manufacturing sites, production & logistics operations, and in supporting Mexico-based incident & investigation management.

This role is ideal for a professional looking to develop expertise in the intelligence cycle within a corporate security environment, with a strong focus on regional risk (Mexico/Latin America) and progressively on BRP global operations.

Key Responsibilities

Intelligence Monitoring, Collection and Proactivity

Conduct continuous monitoring of regional (Mexico/LATAM) security risks, including crime and safety awareness, transnational criminal organizations, foreign terrorist organizations, and geopolitical trends, using internal and external tools and sources.
Track news, social media, government advisories, and intelligence alerts to identify threats impacting BRP operations, personnel, or supply chain.
Support the maintenance of intelligence trackers, databases, and situational awareness dashboards.
Escalate relevant threats or incidents in a timely manner to the Intelligence Lead.
Be an active participant through AIRIP (Association of International Risk Intelligence Professionals), OSAC (Overseas Security Advisory Council), ASIS, INDEX (Consejo Nacional de la Industria Maquiladora y Manufacturera de Exportación), CLAM (Comité Local de ayuda Mutua), and any other associations of interest.

Analysis & Reporting

Analyze collected information to assess relevance, credibility, and operational impact within the BRP Intelligence Standard and brief the Intelligence Lead, the LATAM Regional Security Manager and Global Security Director (as needed).
Produce and support the development of intelligence deliverables, including:
Monthly Intelligence Reports
Intelligence Advisories, Briefs, and Special Intelligence Reports
Contribute to briefings related to travel safety, site security, and emerging risks.
Ensure intelligence outputs are clear, concise, and actionable for stakeholders.

Incident & Investigation Support

Act as a subject-matter expert on incident classification in the ONTIC System and help Security teams navigate the platform’s processes for investigation management.
Provide analytical support to security incidents and investigations by gathering background intelligence and open-source data.
Help identify patterns or trends across incidents to support proactive risk mitigation.
Support the Mexico Security Team in conducting investigations when required.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Support

Work closely with Global Security team members across regions.
Collaborate with local site teams in Mexico to enhance situational awareness and risk reporting.
Participate in meetings, briefings, and training sessions to deepen knowledge of corporate security practices.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in:

International Relations or Public Policy
Security Studies
Political Science / Law
Criminal Justice
Sociology or History Studies
Criminology
Or a related field

Experience

2-5 years of experience in intelligence analysis, security, risk analysis, or a related field (internships included)
Experience working with open-source intelligence tools or research methodologies is preferred
Familiarity with security risks in Mexico and Latin America is a strong asset

Skills & Capabilities

Strong analytical and research skills with attention to detail
Ability to synthesise complex information into clear written products
Good judgment in assessing the credibility and relevance of information
Proficiency in Google Suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides)
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment
Strong ethical standards with heavy handling of sensitive and confidential information

Languages

Fluent in Spanish and English (spoken and written)

Personal Attributes

Curious, proactive, and eager to learn
Strong ethical mindset and respect for confidentiality
Organized and reliable with good time management
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multicultural, global environment
Team-oriented with strong communication skills

What The Role Offers

Hands-on experience in corporate intelligence and global security operations
Exposure to real-world risk environments affecting manufacturing and supply chains
Opportunity to develop expertise in regional and global threat analysis
Collaboration with an international network of security and intelligence professionals
Strong foundation for career growth in intelligence, security, and risk management

ACKNOWLEDGING THE POWER OF DIVERSITY

BRP is dedicated to nurturing a culture that invites, connects, and propels the ambitions of people of all backgrounds, profiles, beliefs, and experiences. Ultimately, the diversity and uniqueness of our people fuel our ingenuity and set the course for the path ahead!

For this reason, we value diversity and we strive to always push each other forward to build an inclusive workplace where every employee feels like they belong, where they can grow and find meaning.

new_jobs.title: OSINT Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Our Mission Statement

At Aperio Global, we bring together experts in cybersecurity, AI, data analytics, and cloud technologies to solve complex national security challenges. We focus on work where our expertise creates the greatest impact.

Our team includes technologists, Intelligence Community veterans, and security professionals who believe the best solutions come from collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence. From cyber operations and AI platforms to cloud-native software and emerging technologies, our work speaks for itself.

Come Solve With Us

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, retirement savings with company match, generous paid time off, and professional development. We invest in our people because great missions require great teams.

Mid - to Senior Open-Source Analyst

Washington, DC | On-Site | Active and Current TS/SCI Required

Turn Open-Source Information Into Actionable Intelligence

Aperio Global is seeking experienced Mid-Career to Senior Open-Source Analysts to join our mission-focused team supporting critical national security requirements in Washington, DC.

This is an opportunity for intelligence professionals who know how to move beyond simply finding information. We’re looking for analysts who can discover, assess, connect, and interpret publicly available information (PAI) to help illuminate complex problems, identify emerging developments, and deliver intelligence that supports real-world missions.

If you enjoy digging deeper, connecting seemingly unrelated information, and turning large volumes of open-source data into meaningful intelligence, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Do:

As a Mid-Career to Senior Open-Source Analyst, you will:

Conduct analysis using intelligence and information from multiple sources to assess, interpret, forecast, and explain national security issues and emerging developments that are regional or functional in nature.

Provide all-source and open-source analytic support to intelligence collection, operations, investigations, targeting, and other defense intelligence requirements.

Research and exploit publicly available information, social media, digital platforms, commercial databases, and other Internet-based sources.

Apply qualitative and quantitative analytic methodologies to complex intelligence problems.

Remain current on developments in academia, technology, and other disciplines that can enhance intelligence tradecraft and analytic methodology.

Review analytic products for logical arguments, intelligence tradecraft standards, sourcing, and adequate support for conclusions.

Challenge assumptions and test the analytic rigor of intelligence products.

Apply advanced Internet research techniques, including Boolean logic, advanced search methodologies, database exploitation, social networking tools, and commercial or industry-specific resources.

Support complex problem sets, including areas such as cryptocurrency, virtual assets, digital ecosystems, and emerging technologies.

What You Bring:

U.S. Citizenship

Active TS/SCI security clearance

Bachelor’s degree

Demonstrated experience using Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) tools and methodologies

Experience working with complex problem sets such as cryptocurrency and virtual assets

Professional experience related to OSINT research, collection management, intelligence analysis, PAI exploitation, or social media exploitation

Experience accessing, researching, and exploiting global and regional social media and digital platforms

Experience conducting open-source research, all-source intelligence analysis, or targeting

Knowledge of advanced Internet-based research techniques, including Boolean logic, advanced search techniques, search engines, specialized databases, social media, social networking tools, and commercial or industry databases

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

Ability to work rotating shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays; to perform under high stress and short suspense; and to travel domestically and internationally (vaccinations may be required).

Why Aperio Global?

At Aperio Global, we bring together intelligence professionals, technologists, engineers, and mission experts to solve difficult national security challenges. We value people who are intellectually curious, technically capable, and willing to challenge assumptions.

Here, you won't simply search for information—you'll help make sense of it, connect it, and turn it into intelligence that matters.

Ready to bring your OSINT expertise to the mission? Join Aperio Global.

Salary Range: 140-180

The salary range for this role represents Aperio’s good-faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Placement within the range is based on multiple factors, including but not limited to an individual’s qualifications, relevant experience, education, certifications, technical skills, contract labor categories and/or rates, work location, market conditions, and business needs.

Benefits

At Aperio Global, we understand the value of investing in our most important asset—our employees. That's why we have crafted a comprehensive benefits package designed to help you make the best decision for yourself, your family and your lifestyle. new_jobs.title: Market Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

The Market Intelligence (MI) team within the Keysight Corporate Strategy Office enables sustained corporate growth by equipping Keysight’s businesses with timely, accurate, and objective insights that drive revenue and profit growth, customer success, and brand loyalty.

A Keysight Market Intelligence Analyst accelerates and improves the quality of corporate strategic decisions by providing research, modeling, and analysis across Keysight’s industries, customers, and competitors. We work with partners across the company to facilitate and influence insights from the external market environment. Key contributions include Keysight’s strategic planning process, macroeconomic and geopolitical assessment, market modeling, growth opportunity assessments, executive and investor relations support, and ad hoc industry, customer and peer analysis. As the external environment continues to change, the job content is characterized as dynamic and thought-provoking.

Keysight SAM & TAM Market Scanning, Analysis and Modeling

Provide a consistent framework and process for creating and updating market models. Identify and track market, competitive, econometric, and industry trends and drivers.
Create thorough and objective financial models and projections
Coordinate, and collaborate with internal industry and solution partners to create consistent models of Keysight’s chosen market segments

Macroeconomic, Industry, Customer, and Peer Analysis

Provide quarterly reporting deliverables, including revenue narratives and market news to support earnings calls
Research market segments, analyze technology trends and customer performance, and monitor and synthesize peer performance
Provide market share performance analysis for Keysight and its key peers, including sub-segment and regional analysis where available

Strategic Consulting

Maintain always-ready market and scenario trackers to support rapid, ad hoc requests from CEO and CSO leadership
Deliver objective analysis of an opportunity space, including market and competitive dynamics, using Keysight standard strategy tools
Identify attributes of a differentiated, sustainable business model, and facilitate value-creation strategy development
Deliver balanced scenario analysis and recommendations to an executive audience while documenting key findings and sources

Modernization of Tools and Processes

Apply AI and automation (e.g., LLM-based agents, automated data pipelines) to streamline research, data gathering, market modeling, and reporting workflows
Use AI-assisted analysis, visualization, and writing tools to elevate the impact and polish of executive deliverables

Qualifications

Expertise:

Understanding growth drivers and dynamics in the automotive, energy, industrial, and semiconductor industries. Familiarity with wireless and wireline telecommunications and aerospace/defense industries.
Knowledge of the economy, financial concepts, corporate accounting, and investor-relations fluency
Skilled in applying AI and automation tools to accelerate research, elevate deliverable quality, and safeguard data integrity
Working knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals

Strategic

Demonstrated ability to quickly acquire an in-depth knowledge of customer, market, competitive, business, and technology situation and integrate it into strategies that deliver sustainable competitive advantage
Demonstrated ability and experience networking with, and quickly mobilizing, key individuals inside and outside the organization to drive strategic dialog and decisions

Process

Demonstrated ability to create and facilitate processes across distributed organizations
Able to triage ambiguous, time-sensitive requests and deliver rigorous analysis on compressed timelines
Skilled in analyzing and summarizing market research and using strategic frameworks
Working proficiency with data and automation tools to build scalable, repeatable models and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Spotfire, Python, Salesforce)
Must be able to effectively communicate orally and in writing on business, strategy, technical, product, and solution issues and tailor to all levels of organization

People

Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and influence individuals and teams
Demonstrated ability to confidently brief senior executives and field real-time follow-up questions, virtually and in person.
Demonstrated ability to work cross-organizationally, form and nurture strong teams, and have a reputation as a collaborative team player

Personal

Demonstrated growth mindset including innate curiosity and eagerness to explore new topics and share learnings
Demonstrated ability to work in areas of high ambiguity with limited information
Demonstrated judgment to make sound business decisions and handle confidential, market-sensitive information appropriately
Energy, enthusiasm, and motivation that excites the same in others

Candidate should have an MBA or minimum 5 years of work experience in market intelligence, business intelligence, business analytics, strategy, corporate development, economics, or finance. An engineering degree (or technical equivalent) is a plus.

Santa Rosa, CA Pay Range: MIN $ 153,000.00 - MAX $ 255,000.00

Colorado Springs, CO Pay Range: MIN $ 141,000.00 - MAX $ 236,000.00

Visa Sponsorship is NOT available for this role.

new_jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Business Intelligence Analyst serves as a strategic partner to business leaders by transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive operational excellence, informed decision-making, and continuous improvement across the organization. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise reporting, dashboards, and analytical solutions while collaborating with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and technical teams to deliver scalable, high-quality business intelligence capabilities.
The position combines strong analytical thinking, advanced SQL expertise, and business acumen to identify trends, solve operational challenges, and support data-driven decision-making throughout NTTA.

Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the United States immediately. This position is not available for H1-B visa sponsorship.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Essential duties and functions, pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include the following. Other related duties may be assigned.

Partner with business stakeholders, operational leaders, and subject matter experts to gather requirements, define success metrics, and deliver business intelligence and analytics solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making. Design, develop, and maintain enterprise dashboards, reports, scorecards, visualizations, and scalable analytics solutions that provide actionable insights into business performance, operational trends, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Serve as the Operations subject matter expert for MicroStrategy and promote reporting best practices, data governance standards, and self-service analytics capabilities. Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and leverage cloud-based data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Azure Synapse to support reporting and analytical initiatives. Develop and maintain reporting solutions using MicroStrategy, Power BI, and other business intelligence platforms to meet evolving business needs. Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and technology teams to ensure data integrity, consistency, and quality across reporting environments. Identify and implement opportunities to automate manual processes, improve reporting efficiency, and increase accessibility of business data across the organization. Support the full reporting lifecycle, including requirements validation, testing, deployment, production support, and issue resolution to ensure reliable delivery of reporting solutions. Utilize GitHub and established development standards to support version control, collaboration, documentation, and release management processes. Document business requirements, technical specifications, and reporting solutions; perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable improvements that enhance performance, reliability, and user experience.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Years of Experience:

Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, data engineering, or a closely related field. To include:
Developing enterprise reporting and business intelligence solutions.
Advanced SQL development and query optimization.
Cloud data warehouse technologies, including BigQuery, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse, or equivalent platforms.
Dashboard and report creating utilizing business intelligence tools such as MicroStrategy, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and visualization solutions.
Business requirements gathering, documentation, analysis, and translation into technical solutions.
GitHub and version-control best practices.
Stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration to deliver reporting and analytics solutions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Master's degree
Seven (7) or more years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or data engineering. To Include:
Tolling, transportation, public sector, or related operational environments.
Operational analytics and back-office systems within the tolling industry.
Creation of wireframes, prototypes, data models, and proof-of-concept reporting solutions.
Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or other cloud computing environments.
Enterprise reporting governance, data quality management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Treizième mois

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge. 

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.
